sociilabs/claude-content-writer/content-.title: content-writer
sociilabs/claude-content-writer/content-.description:
Professional content generation system with GSD-style phased workflow, integrated SEO 
optimization (claude-seo), and anti-AI auditing (humanizer). Features URL-based profile 
creation with automatic tone detection and comprehensive brand questionnaire. Generates 
blog articles, social media posts (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram), email content 
(newsletters, campaigns, sequences), web content (landing pages, product pages, web pages), 
sales content (sales funnels, case studies, testimonials, product descriptions), and SEO 
metadata using best-in-class copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB, LEMA, CONVERT). All 
content sounds human — not AI-generated. Triggers on: "/writer:discuss", "/writer:plan", 
"/writer:execute", "/writer:verify", "/writer:ship", "/writer:profile-create", or any 
request to write content, manage profiles, or create marketing materials.
sociilabs/claude-content-writer/content-.descriptionEn:
Professional content generation system with GSD-style phased workflow, integrated SEO 
optimization (claude-seo), and anti-AI auditing (humanizer). Features URL-based profile 
creation with automatic tone detection and comprehensive brand questionnaire. Generates 
blog articles, social media posts (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram), email content 
(newsletters, campaigns, sequences), web content (landing pages, product pages, web pages), 
sales content (sales funnels, case studies, testimonials, product descriptions), and SEO 
metadata using best-in-class copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB, LEMA, CONVERT). All 
content sounds human — not AI-generated. Triggers on: "/writer:discuss", "/writer:plan", 
"/writer:execute", "/writer:verify", "/writer:ship", "/writer:profile-create", or any 
request to write content, manage profiles, or create marketing materials.
sociilabs/claude-content-writer/content-.descriptionCn:
专业内容生成系统，具有 GSD 式分阶段工作流程、集成 SEO 
优化（claude-seo）和反人工智能审核（人性化）。具有基于 URL 的配置文件 
通过自动音调检测和全面的品牌调查问卷进行创作。生成 
博客文章、社交媒体帖子（LinkedIn、Facebook、Twitter、Instagram）、电子邮件内容 
（时事通讯、活动、序列）、网页内容（登陆页面、产品页面、网页）、 
销售内容（销售漏斗、案例研究、推荐、产品描述）和 SEO 
使用一流的文案框架（AIDA、PAS、BAB、LEMA、CONVERT）来处理元数据。全部 
内容听起来很人性化——不是人工智能生成的。触发条件：“/writer:discuss”、“/writer:plan”、 
“/writer:execute”、“/writer:verify”、“/writer:ship”、“/writer:profile-create”或任何 
请求撰写内容、管理个人资料或创建营销材料。

stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-edit-e.descriptionCn: 设置 Domo 的嵌入式编辑体验 — 外部用户通过嵌入式 iframe 创建、编辑、保存和共享 Domo 内容。涵盖身份代理、JWT 身份验证、基于角色的访问（管理员/特权/编辑者/参与者）、实例映射和编辑 URL 生成。用于任何 Domo 编辑模式嵌入。不适用于只读嵌入（使用 cap-de-programmatic-filters）或客户端过滤（使用 cap-de-jsapi-filters）。

stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-jsapi-.title: cap-de-jsapi-filters

Not for server-side programmatic filters (use cap-de-programmatic-filters).
stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-jsapi-.descriptionEn: Apply runtime filters to embedded Domo dashboards/cards from the host page via the JS API (MessagePort). stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-progra.title: cap-de-programmatic-filters
stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-progra.description: Control which data each viewer sees in an embedded Domo dashboard/card via server-side programmatic filters and dataset switching. Covers the OAuth → embed token flow, standard filters, SQL filters (OR/BETWEEN/LIKE), per-dataset targeting, datasetRedirects for multi-tenant architectures, and token size limits. Use for any per-viewer, per-role, or per-tenant data restrictions at embed time. Not for client-side JS API filtering (use cap-de-jsapi-filters).
stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-progra.descriptionEn: Control which data each viewer sees in an embedded Domo dashboard/card via server-side programmatic filters and dataset switching. stahura/domo-ai-vibe-rules/cap-de-progra.descriptionCn: 通过服务器端编程过滤器和数据集切换，控制每个查看者在嵌入式 Domo 仪表板/卡中看到的数据。涵盖 OAuth → 嵌入令牌流、标准过滤器、SQL 过滤器（OR/BETWEEN/LIKE）、每个数据集定位、多租户架构的数据集重定向以及令牌大小限制。用于嵌入时的任何每个查看者、每个角色或每个租户的数据限制。不适用于客户端 JS API 过滤（使用 cap-de-jsapi-filters）。

statik/skills/dns-troubleshooter.descriptionEn: It's not DNS / There's no way it's DNS / It was DNS. Diagnose and troubleshoot DNS issues including delegation verification, record conflicts, authoritative vs local DNS comparison, and SPF validation. Use when encountering NXDOMAIN errors for URLs that should exist, verifying DNS delegation is correct, checking for conflicting DNS records, comparing what authoritative nameservers say vs local resolvers, or validating SPF records for email deliverability.
statik/skills/dns-troubleshooter.descriptionCn: 这不是 DNS / 这不可能是 DNS / 这是 DNS。诊断和解决 DNS 问题，包括委派验证、记录冲突、权威 DNS 与本地 DNS 比较以及 SPF 验证。当遇到应该存在的 URL 的 NXDOMAIN 错误、验证 DNS 委派是否正确、检查冲突的 DNS 记录、比较权威域名服务器与本地解析器的内容或验证 SPF 记录以确保电子邮件可送达时，请使用此方法。

statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig.title: statsig
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig.description: Use the Statsig MCP to inspect and manage Statsig entities such as gates, experiments, dynamic configs, segments, metrics, audit logs, and results.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig.descriptionEn: Use the Statsig MCP to inspect and manage Statsig entities such as gates, experiments, dynamic configs, segments, metrics, audit logs, and results.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig.descriptionCn: 使用 Statsig MCP 检查和管理 Statsig 实体，例如门、实验、动态配置、分段、指标、审核日志和结果。

statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-create-c.title: statsig-create-cloud-metric
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-create-c.description: Create Statsig Cloud metrics via the Console API POST /console/v1/metrics. Use when drafting or executing Create Metric requests for Cloud projects, including required fields and metric type differences.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-create-c.descriptionEn: Create Statsig Cloud metrics via the Console API POST /console/v1/metrics. Use when drafting or executing Create Metric requests for Cloud projects, including required fields and metric type differences.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-create-c.descriptionCn: 通过控制台 API POST /console/v1/metrics 创建 Statsig Cloud 指标。在为云项目起草或执行创建指标请求时使用，包括必填字段和指标类型差异。

statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-dashboar.title: statsig-dashboard
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-dashboar.description: Create or read Statsig dashboards through the Console API. Use when building a valid `POST /console/v1/dashboards` body, reading `GET /console/v1/dashboards/{id}` into a create-compatible shape, or appending or replacing dashboard widgets through the related widget endpoints.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-dashboar.descriptionEn: Create or read Statsig dashboards through the Console API. Use when building a valid `POST /console/v1/dashboards` body, reading `GET /console/v1/dashboards/{id}` into a create-compatible shape, or appending or replacing dashboard widgets through the related widget endpoints.
statsig-io/agent-skills/statsig-dashboar.descriptionCn: 通过控制台 API 创建或读取 Statsig 仪表板。在构建有效的“POST /console/v1/dashboards”主体、将“GET /console/v1/dashboards/{id}”读取为创建兼容的形状，或通过相关小部件端点附加或替换仪表板小部件时使用。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/bruges.title: bruges
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/bruges.description:
Geophysical equations and rock physics calculations for seismic analysis.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Calculate AVO responses (Zoeppritz, Shuey, Aki-Richards),
(2) Perform Gassmann fluid substitution, (3) Generate seismic wavelets (Ricker, Ormsby),
(4) Compute reflectivity and synthetic seismograms, (5) Calculate elastic moduli from
velocities, (6) Apply Gardner/Castagna empirical relations, (7) Model rock physics effects.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/bruges.descriptionEn:
Geophysical equations and rock physics calculations for seismic analysis.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Calculate AVO responses (Zoeppritz, Shuey, Aki-Richards),
(2) Perform Gassmann fluid substitution, (3) Generate seismic wavelets (Ricker, Ormsby),
(4) Compute reflectivity and synthetic seismograms, (5) Calculate elastic moduli from
velocities, (6) Apply Gardner/Castagna empirical relations, (7) Model rock physics effects.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/bruges.descriptionCn:
用于地震分析的地球物理方程和岩石物理计算。
当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 计算 AVO 响应（Zoeppritz、Shuey、Aki-Richards），
(2) 执行 Gassmann 流体替换，(3) 生成地震子波（Ricker、Ormsby），
(4) 计算反射率和合成地震图，(5) 计算弹性模量
速度，(6) 应用 Gardner/Castagna 经验关系，(7) 模拟岩石物理效应。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/devito.title: devito
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/devito.description:
Symbolic PDE solver with automatic code generation for finite-difference
computations. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Perform seismic wave propagation
modeling, (2) Implement acoustic or elastic wave equations, (3) Run forward
modeling for shot gathers, (4) Set up Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) workflows,
(5) Implement Reverse Time Migration (RTM), (6) Create absorbing boundary
conditions, (7) Generate optimized stencil code for CPUs/GPUs, (8) Solve
custom PDEs with finite differences.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/devito.descriptionEn:
Symbolic PDE solver with automatic code generation for finite-difference
computations. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Perform seismic wave propagation
modeling, (2) Implement acoustic or elastic wave equations, (3) Run forward
modeling for shot gathers, (4) Set up Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) workflows,
(5) Implement Reverse Time Migration (RTM), (6) Create absorbing boundary
conditions, (7) Generate optimized stencil code for CPUs/GPUs, (8) Solve
custom PDEs with finite differences.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/devito.descriptionCn:
具有自动有限差分代码生成功能的符号 PDE 求解器
计算。当 Claude 需要： (1) 进行地震波传播时使用
建模，(2) 实现声波或弹性波方程，(3) 向前运行
炮集建模，(4) 设置全波形反演 (FWI) 工作流程，
(5) 实施逆时偏移 (RTM)，(6) 创建吸收边界
条件，(7) 为 CPU/GPU 生成优化的模板代码，(8) 求解
具有有限差分的自定义偏微分方程。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/disba.title: disba
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/disba.description:
Compute surface wave dispersion curves for layered Earth models using the
Thomson-Haskell matrix method with Numba acceleration. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Calculate Rayleigh or Love wave phase velocities, (2) Compute group velocity
dispersion, (3) Generate sensitivity kernels for inversion, (4) Forward model
dispersion curves from velocity profiles, (5) Compare dispersion between different
Earth models, (6) Set up surface wave tomography workflows.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/disba.descriptionEn:
Compute surface wave dispersion curves for layered Earth models using the
Thomson-Haskell matrix method with Numba acceleration. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Calculate Rayleigh or Love wave phase velocities, (2) Compute group velocity
dispersion, (3) Generate sensitivity kernels for inversion, (4) Forward model
dispersion curves from velocity profiles, (5) Compare dispersion between different
Earth models, (6) Set up surface wave tomography workflows.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/disba.descriptionCn:
使用以下公式计算分层地球模型的表面波频散曲线
具有 Numba 加速功能的 Thomson-Haskell 矩阵方法。当克劳德需要时使用：
(1) 计算瑞利波或勒夫波相速度，(2) 计算群速度
色散，(3) 生成反演的灵敏度核，(4) 正向模型
速度剖面的色散曲线，(5) 比较不同色散之间的色散
地球模型，(6) 设置表面波断层扫描工作流程。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/dlisio.title: dlisio
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/dlisio.description:
Read and parse DLIS (Digital Log Interchange Standard) and LIS (Log Information
Standard) well log files. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read/parse DLIS or LIS
files, (2) Extract well log curves as numpy arrays, (3) Access file metadata and
origin information, (4) Handle multi-frame or multi-file DLIS, (5) Convert DLIS
to LAS or DataFrame, (6) Work with RP66 format well logs, (7) Process array or
image log data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/dlisio.descriptionEn:
Read and parse DLIS (Digital Log Interchange Standard) and LIS (Log Information
Standard) well log files. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read/parse DLIS or LIS
files, (2) Extract well log curves as numpy arrays, (3) Access file metadata and
origin information, (4) Handle multi-frame or multi-file DLIS, (5) Convert DLIS
to LAS or DataFrame, (6) Work with RP66 format well logs, (7) Process array or
image log data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/dlisio.descriptionCn:
读取并解析DLIS（数字日志交换标准）和LIS（日志信息
标准）测井文件。当 Claude 需要： (1) 读取/解析 DLIS 或 LIS 时使用
文件，(2) 将测井曲线提取为 numpy 数组，(3) 访问文件元数据以及
原点信息，(4)处理多帧或多文件DLIS，(5)转换DLIS
到 LAS 或 DataFrame，(6) 使用 RP66 格式测井曲线，(7) 处理阵列或
图像日志数据。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gemgis.title: gemgis
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gemgis.description:
Spatial data processing for geological modelling with GemPy. Use when Claude
needs to: (1) Prepare spatial data for GemPy models, (2) Extract interface
points from geological maps, (3) Process orientations/dip measurements,
(4) Sample DEMs along profiles or cross-sections, (5) Convert between GIS
formats and GemPy inputs, (6) Clip/transform vector/raster data for modeling,
(7) Create model extents from geospatial bounds.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gemgis.descriptionEn:
Spatial data processing for geological modelling with GemPy. Use when Claude
needs to: (1) Prepare spatial data for GemPy models, (2) Extract interface
points from geological maps, (3) Process orientations/dip measurements,
(4) Sample DEMs along profiles or cross-sections, (5) Convert between GIS
formats and GemPy inputs, (6) Clip/transform vector/raster data for modeling,
(7) Create model extents from geospatial bounds.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gemgis.descriptionCn:
使用 GemPy 进行地质建模的空间数据处理。当克劳德
需要：（1）为 GemPy 模型准备空间数据，（2）提取接口
地质图上的点，(3) 过程方向/倾角测量，
(4) 沿剖面或横截面采样 DEM，(5) 在 GIS 之间转换
格式和 GemPy 输入，(6) 剪辑/变换矢量/栅格数据以进行建模，
(7) 根据地理空间边界创建模型范围。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gempy.title: gempy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gempy.description:
3D structural geological modeling using implicit methods. Create geological
models with faults, folds, and unconformities from surface points and
orientations. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build 3D geological models from
surface contacts and orientations, (2) Model faults, unconformities, or
intrusions, (3) Compute and visualize subsurface geology, (4) Export models
to VTK or numpy arrays, (5) Generate gravity forward models, (6) Create
cross-sections or 3D visualizations.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gempy.descriptionEn:
3D structural geological modeling using implicit methods. Create geological
models with faults, folds, and unconformities from surface points and
orientations. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build 3D geological models from
surface contacts and orientations, (2) Model faults, unconformities, or
intrusions, (3) Compute and visualize subsurface geology, (4) Export models
to VTK or numpy arrays, (5) Generate gravity forward models, (6) Create
cross-sections or 3D visualizations.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gempy.descriptionCn:
使用隐式方法进行 3D 结构地质建模。创造地质
具有断层、褶皱和表面点不整合的模型
方向。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 构建 3D 地质模型
表面接触和方向，(2) 模型断层、不整合面，或
入侵，(3) 计算和可视化地下地质，(4) 导出模型
到 VTK 或 numpy 数组，(5) 生成重力前向模型，(6) 创建
横截面或 3D 可视化。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/geostat.title: geostatspy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/geostat.description:
GSLIB-inspired geostatistics library for variogram analysis, kriging, and
simulation. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Calculate experimental variograms,
(2) Fit variogram models, (3) Perform simple/ordinary kriging, (4) Run
sequential Gaussian simulation (SGSIM), (5) Apply normal score transforms,
(6) Decluster spatial data, (7) Generate multiple realizations for uncertainty.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/geostat.descriptionEn:
GSLIB-inspired geostatistics library for variogram analysis, kriging, and
simulation. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Calculate experimental variograms,
(2) Fit variogram models, (3) Perform simple/ordinary kriging, (4) Run
sequential Gaussian simulation (SGSIM), (5) Apply normal score transforms,
(6) Decluster spatial data, (7) Generate multiple realizations for uncertainty.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/geostat.descriptionCn:
受 GSLIB 启发的地质统计学库，用于变异函数分析、克里金法和
模拟。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 计算实验变异函数，
(2) 拟合变异函数模型，(3) 执行简单/普通克里金法，(4) 运行
顺序高斯模拟 (SGSIM)，(5) 应用正态分数变换，
(6) 对空间数据进行分簇，(7) 生成不确定性的多重实现。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gnnwr.title: gnnwr
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gnnwr.description:
Spatial and spatiotemporal regression with GNNWR (Geographically Neural Network
Weighted Regression). Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build spatially varying coefficient
regression models, (2) Analyze geographic non-stationarity in spatial data,
(3) Generate spatial coefficient maps for publication, (4) Run spatiotemporal
regression with GTNNWR, (5) Scale geographically weighted regression to large
datasets (N > 10k) with KNN mode, (6) Diagnose spatial model performance with
F-tests, AIC, and residual maps.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gnnwr.descriptionEn:
Spatial and spatiotemporal regression with GNNWR (Geographically Neural Network
Weighted Regression). Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build spatially varying coefficient
regression models, (2) Analyze geographic non-stationarity in spatial data,
(3) Generate spatial coefficient maps for publication, (4) Run spatiotemporal
regression with GTNNWR, (5) Scale geographically weighted regression to large
datasets (N > 10k) with KNN mode, (6) Diagnose spatial model performance with
F-tests, AIC, and residual maps.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gnnwr.descriptionCn:
使用 GNNWR（地理神经网络）进行空间和时空回归
加权回归）。当 Claude 需要时使用： (1) 构建空间变化系数
回归模型，(2) 分析空间数据中的地理非平稳性，
(3) 生成空间系数图以供发布，(4) 运行时空
使用 GTNNWR 进行回归，(5) 将地理加权回归放大
使用 KNN 模式的数据集 (N > 10k)，(6) 诊断空间模型性能
F 检验、AIC 和残差图。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gprpy.title: gprpy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gprpy.description:
Process and visualize ground-penetrating radar (GPR) data with signal processing,
velocity analysis, and depth conversion. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Load GPR
files (.DZT, .DT1, .GPR, .rd3), (2) Apply dewow, gain, and filters to radargrams,
(3) Convert two-way travel time to depth, (4) Perform CMP/WARR velocity analysis,
(5) Apply topographic corrections, (6) Export processed profiles as images or SEG-Y,
(7) Batch process multiple GPR survey lines.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gprpy.descriptionEn:
Process and visualize ground-penetrating radar (GPR) data with signal processing,
velocity analysis, and depth conversion. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Load GPR
files (.DZT, .DT1, .GPR, .rd3), (2) Apply dewow, gain, and filters to radargrams,
(3) Convert two-way travel time to depth, (4) Perform CMP/WARR velocity analysis,
(5) Apply topographic corrections, (6) Export processed profiles as images or SEG-Y,
(7) Batch process multiple GPR survey lines.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/gprpy.descriptionCn:
通过信号处理来处理和可视化探地雷达 (GPR) 数据，
速度分析和深度转换。当 Claude 需要： (1) 加载 GPR 时使用
文件（.DZT、.DT1、.GPR、.rd3），(2) 将露波、增益和滤波器应用于雷达图，
(3) 将双向行进时间转换为深度，(4) 执行 CMP/WARR 速度分析，
(5) 应用地形校正，(6) 将处理后的轮廓导出为图像或 SEG-Y，
(7)批量处理多条探地雷达测线。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/harmoni.title: harmonica
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/harmoni.description:
Gravity and magnetic data processing and forward modelling using Fatiando a Terra.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Compute gravity forward models (point masses, prisms,
tesseroids), (2) Apply terrain/Bouguer corrections, (3) Grid scattered potential
field data with equivalent sources, (4) Perform upward/downward continuation,
(5) Calculate magnetic anomalies from magnetized bodies, (6) Apply derivative
filters (gradients, tilt angle), (7) Process regional or local gravity surveys.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/harmoni.descriptionEn:
Gravity and magnetic data processing and forward modelling using Fatiando a Terra.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Compute gravity forward models (point masses, prisms,
tesseroids), (2) Apply terrain/Bouguer corrections, (3) Grid scattered potential
field data with equivalent sources, (4) Perform upward/downward continuation,
(5) Calculate magnetic anomalies from magnetized bodies, (6) Apply derivative
filters (gradients, tilt angle), (7) Process regional or local gravity surveys.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/harmoni.descriptionCn:
使用 Fatiando a Terra 进行重力和磁力数据处理和正向建模。
当 Claude 需要时使用：(1) 计算重力正演模型（点质量、棱镜、
tesseroids），（2）应用地形/布格校正，（3）网格分散势
具有等效来源的现场数据，（4）执行向上/向下延续，
(5) 计算磁化体的磁异常，(6) 应用导数
过滤器（梯度、倾斜角），(7) 处理区域或局部重力调查。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/landlab.title: landlab
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/landlab.description:
Landscape evolution and surface process modelling in Python. Build 2D numerical
models for erosion, hydrology, soil transport, and geomorphology. Use when Claude
needs to: (1) Model landscape evolution over time, (2) Simulate river/stream erosion,
(3) Route water flow across terrain, (4) Model hillslope diffusion processes,
(5) Simulate weathering and soil production, (6) Analyze drainage networks,
(7) Combine multiple geomorphic processes, (8) Load/save DEM data for modeling.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/landlab.descriptionEn:
Landscape evolution and surface process modelling in Python. Build 2D numerical
models for erosion, hydrology, soil transport, and geomorphology. Use when Claude
needs to: (1) Model landscape evolution over time, (2) Simulate river/stream erosion,
(3) Route water flow across terrain, (4) Model hillslope diffusion processes,
(5) Simulate weathering and soil production, (6) Analyze drainage networks,
(7) Combine multiple geomorphic processes, (8) Load/save DEM data for modeling.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/landlab.descriptionCn:
Python 中的景观演化和地表过程建模。构建二维数值
侵蚀、水文学、土壤迁移和地貌模型。当克劳德
需要：(1) 模拟景观随时间的演变，(2) 模拟河流/溪流侵蚀，
(3) 引导水流穿过地形，(4) 模拟山坡扩散过程，
(5) 模拟风化和土壤生产，(6) 分析排水网络，
(7) 组合多个地貌过程，(8) 加载/保存 DEM 数据以进行建模。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/lasio.title: lasio
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/lasio.description:
Read, write, and manipulate LAS (Log ASCII Standard) well log files for borehole
geophysical and petrophysical data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read/parse LAS
1.2 or 2.0 files, (2) Extract well headers or curve data, (3) Convert LAS to
DataFrame/CSV/Excel, (4) Create new LAS files from arrays, (5) Modify existing
LAS files, (6) Handle problematic or malformed LAS files, (7) Batch process
multiple well files.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/lasio.descriptionEn:
Read, write, and manipulate LAS (Log ASCII Standard) well log files for borehole
geophysical and petrophysical data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read/parse LAS
1.2 or 2.0 files, (2) Extract well headers or curve data, (3) Convert LAS to
DataFrame/CSV/Excel, (4) Create new LAS files from arrays, (5) Modify existing
LAS files, (6) Handle problematic or malformed LAS files, (7) Batch process
multiple well files.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/lasio.descriptionCn:
读取、写入和操作钻孔的 LAS（Log ASCII 标准）测井文件
地球物理和岩石物理数据。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 读取/解析 LAS
1.2 或 2.0 文件，(2) 提取井标或曲线数据，(3) 将 LAS 转换为
DataFrame/CSV/Excel，(4) 从数组创建新的 LAS 文件，(5) 修改现有的
LAS 文件，(6) 处理有问题或格式错误的 LAS 文件，(7) 批处理
多个井文件。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/loopstr.title: loopstructural
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/loopstr.description:
Build 3D geological models with implicit surfaces, faults, folds, and stratigraphic
constraints from structural geology data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build 3D
geological models from structural data, (2) Model fault networks and displacements,
(3) Create folded geology representations, (4) Interpolate geological surfaces,
(5) Export models to VTK for visualization, (6) Perform uncertainty analysis on
geological models, (7) Evaluate model values on grids.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/loopstr.descriptionEn:
Build 3D geological models with implicit surfaces, faults, folds, and stratigraphic
constraints from structural geology data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Build 3D
geological models from structural data, (2) Model fault networks and displacements,
(3) Create folded geology representations, (4) Interpolate geological surfaces,
(5) Export models to VTK for visualization, (6) Perform uncertainty analysis on
geological models, (7) Evaluate model values on grids.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/loopstr.descriptionCn:
构建具有隐式表面、断层、褶皱和地层的 3D 地质模型
来自构造地质数据的约束。当 Claude 需要时使用：(1) 构建 3D
来自结构数据的地质模型，(2) 模型断层网络和位移，
(3) 创建折叠地质表示，(4) 插值地质表面，
(5) 将模型导出到 VTK 进行可视化， (6) 对模型进行不确定性分析
地质模型，(7) 评估网格上的模型值。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mplster.title: mplstereonet
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mplster.description:
Stereonet plots for structural geology using matplotlib. Create lower-hemisphere
stereographic projections for orientation data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create
stereonet plots for structural data, (2) Plot planes as great circles or poles,
(3) Plot lineations with trend/plunge, (4) Generate density contours for orientations,
(5) Calculate mean orientations and statistics, (6) Analyze fold axes with pi-diagrams,
(7) Convert between strike/dip and trend/plunge formats.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mplster.descriptionEn:
Stereonet plots for structural geology using matplotlib. Create lower-hemisphere
stereographic projections for orientation data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create
stereonet plots for structural data, (2) Plot planes as great circles or poles,
(3) Plot lineations with trend/plunge, (4) Generate density contours for orientations,
(5) Calculate mean orientations and statistics, (6) Analyze fold axes with pi-diagrams,
(7) Convert between strike/dip and trend/plunge formats.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mplster.descriptionCn:
使用 matplotlib 绘制构造地质学立体图。创建下半球
方向数据的立体投影。当 Claude 需要时使用： (1) 创建
结构数据的立体图，(2) 将平面绘制为大圆或极点，
(3) 绘制趋势/暴跌线状图，(4) 生成方向的密度等值线，
(5) 计算平均方向和统计数据，(6) 用 pi 图分析折叠轴，
(7) 在罢工/下跌和趋势/暴跌格式之间转换。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mtpy.title: mtpy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mtpy.description:
Magnetotelluric data processing and modelling. Read EDI files, analyze MT
responses, perform inversions, and visualize resistivity models. Use when
Claude needs to: (1) Read/write EDI files, (2) Process MT impedance tensors,
(3) Analyze phase tensors and dimensionality, (4) Plot apparent resistivity
and phase curves, (5) Create pseudosections, (6) Perform strike analysis,
(7) Run 1D inversions, (8) Prepare data for 2D/3D modelling.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mtpy.descriptionEn:
Magnetotelluric data processing and modelling. Read EDI files, analyze MT
responses, perform inversions, and visualize resistivity models. Use when
Claude needs to: (1) Read/write EDI files, (2) Process MT impedance tensors,
(3) Analyze phase tensors and dimensionality, (4) Plot apparent resistivity
and phase curves, (5) Create pseudosections, (6) Perform strike analysis,
(7) Run 1D inversions, (8) Prepare data for 2D/3D modelling.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/mtpy.descriptionCn:
大地电磁数据处理和建模。读取EDI文件，分析MT
响应、执行反演以及可视化电阻率模型。使用时
Claude 需要：(1) 读/写 EDI 文件，(2) 处理 MT 阻抗张量，
(3) 分析相位张量和维数，(4) 绘制视电阻率
和相位曲线，(5) 创建伪剖面，(6) 执行走向分析，
(7) 运行 1D 反演，(8) 准备 2D/3D 建模数据。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/obspy.title: obspy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/obspy.description:
Seismology data processing with ObsPy. Helps with reading seismic waveforms,
filtering/processing time series, fetching data from FDSN services, and
earthquake analysis. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read seismic data formats
(MiniSEED, SAC, GSE2, SEGY), (2) Filter or process waveforms, (3) Fetch data
from IRIS/USGS/FDSN services, (4) Search for earthquakes by magnitude/location,
(5) Plot seismograms or spectrograms, (6) Remove instrument response,
(7) Analyze station metadata.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/obspy.descriptionEn:
Seismology data processing with ObsPy. Helps with reading seismic waveforms,
filtering/processing time series, fetching data from FDSN services, and
earthquake analysis. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Read seismic data formats
(MiniSEED, SAC, GSE2, SEGY), (2) Filter or process waveforms, (3) Fetch data
from IRIS/USGS/FDSN services, (4) Search for earthquakes by magnitude/location,
(5) Plot seismograms or spectrograms, (6) Remove instrument response,
(7) Analyze station metadata.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/obspy.descriptionCn:
使用 ObsPy 处理地震数据。帮助读取地震波形，
过滤/处理时间序列，从 FDSN 服务获取数据，以及
地震分析。当 Claude 需要： (1) 读取地震数据格式时使用
（MiniSEED、SAC、GSE2、SEGY），(2) 过滤或处理波形，(3) 获取数据
来自 IRIS/USGS/FDSN 服务，(4) 按震级/位置搜索地震，
(5) 绘制地震图或频谱图， (6) 删除仪器响应，
(7) 分析站元数据。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pastas.title: pastas
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pastas.description:
Groundwater time series analysis and modelling using transfer function noise
models. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Analyze groundwater level time series,
(2) Model well responses to precipitation/pumping, (3) Calibrate aquifer
parameters from head data, (4) Forecast or hindcast groundwater levels,
(5) Decompose hydrological signals into components, (6) Compare response
functions, (7) Perform model diagnostics and uncertainty analysis.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pastas.descriptionEn:
Groundwater time series analysis and modelling using transfer function noise
models. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Analyze groundwater level time series,
(2) Model well responses to precipitation/pumping, (3) Calibrate aquifer
parameters from head data, (4) Forecast or hindcast groundwater levels,
(5) Decompose hydrological signals into components, (6) Compare response
functions, (7) Perform model diagnostics and uncertainty analysis.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pastas.descriptionCn:
使用传递函数噪声进行地下水时间序列分析和建模
模型。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 分析地下水位时间序列，
(2) 模拟井对降水/抽水的响应，(3) 校准含水层
来自水头数据的参数，(4) 预测或事后地下水位，
(5) 将水文信号分解为多个分量，(6) 比较响应
函数，(7) 执行模型诊断和不确定性分析。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/petropy.title: petropy
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/petropy.description:
Petrophysical analysis and formation evaluation from well logs. Calculate
porosity, water saturation, permeability, and lithology. Use when Claude needs
to: (1) Calculate shale volume from gamma ray, (2) Compute porosity from
density/neutron/sonic logs, (3) Estimate water saturation using Archie or
Simandoux, (4) Calculate permeability from porosity and saturation, (5) Perform
pay zone identification, (6) Conduct multi-mineral analysis, (7) Generate
petrophysical summation plots.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/petropy.descriptionEn:
Petrophysical analysis and formation evaluation from well logs. Calculate
porosity, water saturation, permeability, and lithology. Use when Claude needs
to: (1) Calculate shale volume from gamma ray, (2) Compute porosity from
density/neutron/sonic logs, (3) Estimate water saturation using Archie or
Simandoux, (4) Calculate permeability from porosity and saturation, (5) Perform
pay zone identification, (6) Conduct multi-mineral analysis, (7) Generate
petrophysical summation plots.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/petropy.descriptionCn:
测井岩石物理分析和地层评价。计算
孔隙度、含水饱和度、渗透率和岩性。当克劳德需要时使用
至：(1) 根据伽马射线计算页岩体积，(2) 计算孔隙度
密度/中子/声波测井，(3) 使用 Archie 或估计水饱和度
Simandoux，(4) 根据孔隙度和饱和度计算渗透率，(5) 执行
产层识别，(6) 进行多矿物分析，(7) 生成
岩石物理求和图。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pooch.title: pooch
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pooch.description:
Data file fetching and caching for geoscience applications. Download sample
datasets with automatic caching, checksum verification, and multiple download
sources. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Download datasets from URLs or DOIs,
(2) Cache files locally with automatic verification, (3) Verify file integrity
with SHA256/MD5 hashes, (4) Extract compressed archives (ZIP, TAR, GZIP),
(5) Create data registries for reproducible workflows, (6) Fetch from Zenodo
or other repositories.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pooch.descriptionEn:
Data file fetching and caching for geoscience applications. Download sample
datasets with automatic caching, checksum verification, and multiple download
sources. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Download datasets from URLs or DOIs,
(2) Cache files locally with automatic verification, (3) Verify file integrity
with SHA256/MD5 hashes, (4) Extract compressed archives (ZIP, TAR, GZIP),
(5) Create data registries for reproducible workflows, (6) Fetch from Zenodo
or other repositories.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pooch.descriptionCn:
地球科学应用程序的数据文件获取和缓存。下载样本
具有自动缓存、校验和验证和多次下载的数据集
来源。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 从 URL 或 DOI 下载数据集，
(2)本地缓存文件并自动验证，(3)验证文件完整性
使用 SHA256/MD5 哈希值，(4) 提取压缩档案（ZIP、TAR、GZIP），
(5) 为可重复的工作流程创建数据注册表，(6) 从 Zenodo 获取
或其他存储库。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pygimli.title: pygimli
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pygimli.description:
Multi-method geophysical modelling and inversion framework. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Perform electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) inversion, (2) Run seismic refraction
tomography (SRT), (3) Model induced polarization (IP) data, (4) Simulate ground penetrating
radar (GPR), (5) Create finite element meshes for geophysical problems, (6) Perform joint
inversions of multiple datasets, (7) Forward model geophysical responses, (8) Analyze
time-lapse monitoring data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pygimli.descriptionEn:
Multi-method geophysical modelling and inversion framework. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Perform electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) inversion, (2) Run seismic refraction
tomography (SRT), (3) Model induced polarization (IP) data, (4) Simulate ground penetrating
radar (GPR), (5) Create finite element meshes for geophysical problems, (6) Perform joint
inversions of multiple datasets, (7) Forward model geophysical responses, (8) Analyze
time-lapse monitoring data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pygimli.descriptionCn:
多方法地球物理建模和反演框架。当克劳德需要时使用：
(1) 进行电阻率层析成像 (ERT) 反演，(2) 运行地震折射
断层扫描 (SRT)，(3) 模型激发极化 (IP) 数据，(4) 模拟探地
雷达 (GPR)，(5) 为地球物理问题创建有限元网格，(6) 执行联合
多个数据集的反演，(7) 正演模型地球物理响应，(8) 分析
延时监测数据。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pylops.title: pylops
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pylops.description:
Linear operators for large-scale inverse problems with matrix-free representations.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Define linear operators for forward/adjoint operations,
(2) Solve inverse problems (deconvolution, imaging, tomography), (3) Apply signal
processing transforms (FFT, convolution, derivatives), (4) Compose operators for
complex workflows, (5) Perform regularized inversion with smoothness or sparsity
constraints, (6) Process seismic or image data at scale.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pylops.descriptionEn:
Linear operators for large-scale inverse problems with matrix-free representations.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Define linear operators for forward/adjoint operations,
(2) Solve inverse problems (deconvolution, imaging, tomography), (3) Apply signal
processing transforms (FFT, convolution, derivatives), (4) Compose operators for
complex workflows, (5) Perform regularized inversion with smoothness or sparsity
constraints, (6) Process seismic or image data at scale.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pylops.descriptionCn:
用于具有无矩阵表示的大规模反问题的线性算子。
当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 为前向/伴随操作定义线性运算符，
(2) 解决反演问题（反卷积、成像、断层扫描），(3) 应用信号
处理变换（FFT、卷积、导数），(4) 组合算子
复杂的工作流程，(5) 平滑或稀疏地执行正则化反演
(6) 大规模处理地震或图像数据。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyrolit.title: pyrolite
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyrolit.description:
Geochemistry data analysis and visualization for igneous, metamorphic, and
sedimentary rocks. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create ternary diagrams for
compositional data, (2) Plot REE spider diagrams with normalization, (3) Build
TAS or other classification diagrams, (4) Apply log-ratio transforms to
compositional data, (5) Calculate CIPW norms, (6) Generate Harker variation
diagrams, (7) Compute element ratios and anomalies.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyrolit.descriptionEn:
Geochemistry data analysis and visualization for igneous, metamorphic, and
sedimentary rocks. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create ternary diagrams for
compositional data, (2) Plot REE spider diagrams with normalization, (3) Build
TAS or other classification diagrams, (4) Apply log-ratio transforms to
compositional data, (5) Calculate CIPW norms, (6) Generate Harker variation
diagrams, (7) Compute element ratios and anomalies.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyrolit.descriptionCn:
火成岩、变质岩和岩浆的地球化学数据分析和可视化
沉积岩。当 Claude 需要： (1) 创建三元图时使用
成分数据，(2) 绘制标准化后的 REE 蜘蛛图，(3) 构建
TAS 或其他分类图，(4) 应用对数比变换
成分数据，(5) 计算 CIPW 范数，(6) 生成 Harker 变异
图表，(7) 计算元素比率和异常。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyvista.title: pyvista
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyvista.description:
3D visualization and mesh analysis for geoscience data using PyVista/VTK.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create 3D visualizations of geological models,
(2) Render seismic volumes or voxel data, (3) Visualize point clouds or well
paths, (4) Plot surfaces and meshes in 3D, (5) Read/write VTK, STL, OBJ files,
(6) Create cross-sections through 3D models, (7) Export publication-quality
figures or interactive HTML.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyvista.descriptionEn:
3D visualization and mesh analysis for geoscience data using PyVista/VTK.
Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create 3D visualizations of geological models,
(2) Render seismic volumes or voxel data, (3) Visualize point clouds or well
paths, (4) Plot surfaces and meshes in 3D, (5) Read/write VTK, STL, OBJ files,
(6) Create cross-sections through 3D models, (7) Export publication-quality
figures or interactive HTML.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/pyvista.descriptionCn:
使用 PyVista/VTK 对地球科学数据进行 3D 可视化和网格分析。
当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 创建地质模型的 3D 可视化，
(2) 渲染地震体或体素数据，(3) 可视化点云或井
路径，(4) 以 3D 形式绘制曲面和网格，(5) 读/写 VTK、STL、OBJ 文件，
(6) 通过 3D 模型创建横截面，(7) 导出出版质量
数字或交互式 HTML。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/scikit-.title: scikit-gstat
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/scikit-.description:
Geostatistical analysis with scikit-learn style API. Compute variograms, kriging
interpolation, and spatial correlation analysis. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Compute
experimental variograms from spatial data, (2) Fit variogram models (spherical,
exponential, gaussian, matern), (3) Perform Ordinary or Universal Kriging interpolation,
(4) Assess spatial anisotropy with directional variograms, (5) Cross-validate spatial
models, (6) Analyze spatio-temporal data, (7) Export variogram parameters for other
geostatistical software.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/scikit-.descriptionEn:
Geostatistical analysis with scikit-learn style API. Compute variograms, kriging
interpolation, and spatial correlation analysis. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Compute
experimental variograms from spatial data, (2) Fit variogram models (spherical,
exponential, gaussian, matern), (3) Perform Ordinary or Universal Kriging interpolation,
(4) Assess spatial anisotropy with directional variograms, (5) Cross-validate spatial
models, (6) Analyze spatio-temporal data, (7) Export variogram parameters for other
geostatistical software.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/scikit-.descriptionCn:
使用 scikit-learn 风格的 API 进行地统计分析。计算变异函数、克里金法
插值和空间相关分析。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 计算
来自空间数据的实验变差函数，(2) 拟合变差函数模型（球形、
指数、高斯、马特恩），(3) 执行普通克里金插值或通用克里金插值，
(4) 使用方向变异函数评估空间各向异性，(5) 交叉验证空间
模型，(6) 分析时空数据，(7) 导出其他变量的变异函数参数
地统计软件。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/segyio.title: segyio
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/segyio.description:
Read, write, and manipulate SEG-Y seismic data files. Fast C library with Python
bindings for trace, header, inline, and crossline access. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Read/inspect SEG-Y files, (2) Extract trace data or headers, (3) Access 3D survey
data by inline/crossline, (4) Create new SEG-Y files from arrays, (5) Modify existing
SEG-Y files, (6) Extract subsets of seismic data, (7) Read/write Seismic Unix format.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/segyio.descriptionEn:
Read, write, and manipulate SEG-Y seismic data files. Fast C library with Python
bindings for trace, header, inline, and crossline access. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Read/inspect SEG-Y files, (2) Extract trace data or headers, (3) Access 3D survey
data by inline/crossline, (4) Create new SEG-Y files from arrays, (5) Modify existing
SEG-Y files, (6) Extract subsets of seismic data, (7) Read/write Seismic Unix format.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/segyio.descriptionCn:
读取、写入和操作 SEG-Y 地震数据文件。使用 Python 的快速 C 库
用于跟踪、标头、内联和跨联访问的绑定。当克劳德需要时使用：
(1) 读取/检查 SEG-Y 文件，(2) 提取跟踪数据或标题，(3) 访问 3D 测量
按内联/跨联数据，(4) 从数组创建新的 SEG-Y 文件，(5) 修改现有的
SEG-Y 文件，(6) 提取地震数据子集，(7) 读/写 Seismic Unix 格式。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/simpeg.title: simpeg
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/simpeg.description:
Simulation and Parameter Estimation in Geophysics. Framework for geophysical
forward modeling and inversion. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Run geophysical
inversions (DC resistivity, magnetics, gravity, EM), (2) Create forward models
for potential fields or electromagnetic methods, (3) Build survey geometries
and receiver configurations, (4) Design mesh discretizations for simulations,
(5) Apply regularization and optimization to inverse problems, (6) Model
subsurface physical properties from geophysical data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/simpeg.descriptionEn:
Simulation and Parameter Estimation in Geophysics. Framework for geophysical
forward modeling and inversion. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Run geophysical
inversions (DC resistivity, magnetics, gravity, EM), (2) Create forward models
for potential fields or electromagnetic methods, (3) Build survey geometries
and receiver configurations, (4) Design mesh discretizations for simulations,
(5) Apply regularization and optimization to inverse problems, (6) Model
subsurface physical properties from geophysical data.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/simpeg.descriptionCn:
地球物理学中的模拟和参数估计。地球物理框架
正演和反演。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 运行地球物理
反演（直流电阻率、磁力、重力、电磁），(2) 创建正演模型
对于势场或电磁方法，(3) 构建测量几何形状
和接收器配置，(4) 设计用于模拟的网格离散化，
(5) 将正则化和优化应用于反问题，(6) 模型
来自地球物理数据的地下物理特性。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/striplo.title: striplog
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/striplo.description:
Create, visualize, and analyze lithological and stratigraphic logs for well
data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create lithology columns from depth intervals,
(2) Parse geological descriptions into structured logs, (3) Visualize stratigraphic
columns with patterns and colors, (4) Perform well-to-well correlations, (5) Extract
statistics like net-to-gross ratios, (6) Define rock type lexicons and legends,
(7) Export lithology data to CSV/LAS/JSON.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/striplo.descriptionEn:
Create, visualize, and analyze lithological and stratigraphic logs for well
data. Use when Claude needs to: (1) Create lithology columns from depth intervals,
(2) Parse geological descriptions into structured logs, (3) Visualize stratigraphic
columns with patterns and colors, (4) Perform well-to-well correlations, (5) Extract
statistics like net-to-gross ratios, (6) Define rock type lexicons and legends,
(7) Export lithology data to CSV/LAS/JSON.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/striplo.descriptionCn:
创建、可视化和分析井的岩性和地层日志
数据。当 Claude 需要执行以下操作时使用： (1) 从深度区间创建岩性柱，
(2) 将地质描述解析为结构化日志，(3) 可视化地层
具有图案和颜色的列，(4) 执行孔与孔之间的相关性，(5) 提取
净毛比等统计数据，(6) 定义岩石类型词典和图例，
(7) 将岩性数据导出为CSV/LAS/JSON。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/using-g.title: using-geoscience-skills
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/using-g.description:
Foundation skill for the geoscience skills library. Routes user intent
to the correct domain skills, slash commands, and workflow skills.
Loaded automatically at session start via SessionStart hook.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/using-g.descriptionEn:
Foundation skill for the geoscience skills library. Routes user intent
to the correct domain skills, slash commands, and workflow skills.
Loaded automatically at session start via SessionStart hook.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/using-g.descriptionCn:
地球科学技能库的基础技能。路由用户意图
正确的领域技能、斜线命令和工作流程技能。
在会话启动时通过 SessionStart 挂钩自动加载。

steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/verde.title: verde
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/verde.description:
Spatial data gridding and interpolation with a machine-learning style API. Process
geographic and Cartesian point data onto regular grids. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Grid scattered spatial data onto regular grids, (2) Interpolate point data using
splines, linear, or cubic methods, (3) Process geographic coordinates with projections,
(4) Reduce large datasets using block averaging, (5) Remove polynomial trends from
spatial data, (6) Cross-validate gridding parameters, (7) Create processing pipelines
with Chain, (8) Grid vector data like GPS velocities.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/verde.descriptionEn:
Spatial data gridding and interpolation with a machine-learning style API. Process
geographic and Cartesian point data onto regular grids. Use when Claude needs to:
(1) Grid scattered spatial data onto regular grids, (2) Interpolate point data using
splines, linear, or cubic methods, (3) Process geographic coordinates with projections,
(4) Reduce large datasets using block averaging, (5) Remove polynomial trends from
spatial data, (6) Cross-validate gridding parameters, (7) Create processing pipelines
with Chain, (8) Grid vector data like GPS velocities.
steadfastasart/geoscience-skills/verde.descriptionCn:
使用机器学习风格的 API 进行空间数据网格化和插值。工艺流程
地理和笛卡尔点数据到规则网格上。当克劳德需要时使用：
(1) 将分散的空间数据网格化到规则网格上，(2) 使用

swannysec/robot-tools/starduster.title: starduster
swannysec/robot-tools/starduster.description:
Catalog GitHub starred repositories into a structured Obsidian vault with
AI-synthesized summaries, normalized topic taxonomy, graph-optimized
wikilinks, and Obsidian Bases (.base) index files for filtered views.
Fetches repo metadata and READMEs via gh CLI, classifies repos into
categories and normalized topics, generates individual repo notes with
frontmatter, and creates hub notes for categories/topics/authors that
serve as graph-view connection points.

Use this skill when users want to:
(1) Catalog or index their GitHub stars into Obsidian
(2) Create a searchable knowledge base from starred repos
(3) Organize and discover patterns in their GitHub stars
(4) Export GitHub stars as structured markdown notes
(5) Build a graph of starred repos by topic, language, or author

For saving/distilling a specific URL to a note, use kcap instead.
For browsing AI tweets, use ai-twitter-radar instead.

taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/eval.title: evaluating-skills-with-models
taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/eval.description: Evaluate skills by executing them across sonnet, opus, and haiku models using sub-agents. Use when testing if a skill works correctly, comparing model performance, or finding the cheapest compatible model. Returns numeric scores (0-100) to differentiate model capabilities.
taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/eval.descriptionEn: Evaluate skills by executing them across sonnet, opus, and haiku models using sub-agents. taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/eval.descriptionCn: 通过使用子代理在十四行诗、作品和俳句模型中执行技能来评估技能。在测试技能是否正常工作、比较模型性能或查找最便宜的兼容模型时使用。返回数字分数 (0-100) 以区分模型功能。

taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/impr.title: improving-skills
taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/impr.description: Improve existing agent skills based on user feedback and best practices. Use when the user wants to fix, enhance, or refactor an existing skill. Gathers user feedback first, then applies technical analysis and implements improvements.

taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/impr.descriptionCn: 根据用户反馈和最佳实践提高现有代理技能。当用户想要修复、增强或重构现有技能时使用。首先收集用户反馈，然后应用技术分析并实施改进。

taisukeoe/agentic-ai-skills-creator/revi.title: reviewing-plugin-marketplace

takazudo/jlcpcb-parts-finder-skill/jlcpc.title: jlcpcb-component-finder
takazudo/jlcpcb-parts-finder-skill/jlcpc.description: Search the JLCPCB electronic components database (~7 million parts) for hardware/electronics projects. Use when the user needs to: (1) Find electronic components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, ICs, connectors, diodes, transistors, MOSFETs, op-amps, microcontrollers, sensors, LEDs, etc.), (2) Look up specific part numbers, LCSC numbers (C-prefix), or manufacturer part numbers, (3) Find alternatives or equivalents for components, (4) Check component availability and stock at JLCPCB/LCSC, (5) Get component specifications (package type, footprint, description), (6) Search for parts for PCB assembly (PCBA) projects, (7) Find SMD or through-hole components, (8) Look up voltage regulators (LDO, linear, switching), audio jacks, connectors, or any other electronic parts. Keywords: JLCPCB, LCSC, electronic components, PCB parts, SMT assembly, BOM, bill of materials, component sourcing.
takazudo/jlcpcb-parts-finder-skill/jlcpc.descriptionEn: Search the JLCPCB electronic components database (~7 million parts) for hardware/electronics projects. Use when the user needs to: (1) Find electronic components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, ICs, connectors, diodes, transistors, MOSFETs, op-amps, microcontrollers, sensors, LEDs, etc.), (2) Look up specific part numbers, LCSC numbers (C-prefix), or manufacturer part numbers, (3) Find alternatives or equivalents for components, (4) Check component availability and stock at JLCPCB/LCSC, (5) Get component specifications (package type, footprint, description), (6) Search for parts for PCB assembly (PCBA) projects, (7) Find SMD or through-hole components, (8) Look up voltage regulators (LDO, linear, switching), audio jacks, connectors, or any other electronic parts. Keywords: JLCPCB, LCSC, electronic components, PCB parts, SMT assembly, BOM, bill of materials, component sourcing.
takazudo/jlcpcb-parts-finder-skill/jlcpc.descriptionCn: 在 JLCPCB 电子元件数据库（约 700 万个零件）中搜索硬件/电子项目。当用户需要执行以下操作时使用：(1) 查找电子元件（电阻器、电容器、电感器、IC、连接器、二极管、晶体管、MOSFET、运算放大器、微控制器、传感器、LED 等），(2) 查找特定部件号、LCSC 号（C 前缀）或制造商部件号，(3) 查找部件的替代品或等效物，(4) 检查 JLCPCB/LCSC 上的部件可用性和库存，(5) 获取部件规格（封装） (6) 搜索 PCB 组装 (PCBA) 项目的零件，(7) 查找 SMD 或通孔元件，(8) 查找稳压器（LDO、线性、开关）、音频插孔、连接器或任何其他电子零件。关键词：JLCPCB、LCSC、电子元件、PCB 零件、SMT 组装、BOM、物料清单、元件采购。

tanweai/pua/pua.title: pua
tanweai/pua/pua.description: Forces exhaustive problem-solving using corporate PUA rhetoric and structured debugging methodology. MUST trigger when: (1) any task has failed 2+ times or you're stuck in a loop tweaking the same approach; (2) you're about to say 'I cannot', suggest the user do something manually, or blame the environment without verifying; (3) you catch yourself being passive — not searching, not reading source, not verifying, just waiting for instructions; (4) user expresses frustration in ANY form: 'try harder', 'stop giving up', 'figure it out', 'why isn't this working', 'again???', '换个方法', '为什么还不行', '你再试试', '加油', '你怎么又失败了', or any similar sentiment even if phrased differently. Also trigger when facing complex multi-step debugging, environment issues, config problems, or deployment failures where giving up early is tempting. Applies to ALL task types: code, config, research, writing, deployment, infrastructure, API integration. Do NOT trigger on first-attempt failures or when a known fix is already executing successfully.

tanweai/pua/pua.descriptionCn: 强制使用企业 PUA 言辞和结构化调试方法来彻底解决问题。必须在以下情况下触发：(1) 任何任务失败 2 次以上，或者您陷入调整相同方法的循环中； (2) 你要说“我不能”，建议用户手动做一些事情，或者在没有验证的情况下归咎于环境； （3）你发现自己很被动——不搜索、不阅读源码、不验证，只是等待指示； (4) 用户以任何形式表达沮丧：“再努力一点”、“停止放弃”、“弄清楚”、“为什么这不起作用”、“又？？？”、“换个方法”、“为什么还不行”、“你再尝试”、“加油”、“你怎么又失败了”，或任何类似的情绪，即使措辞不同。当面临复杂的多步骤调试、环境问题、配置问题或部署失败时也会触发，而提前放弃很容易。适用于所有任务类型：代码、配置、研究、写作、部署、基础设施、API 集成。不要在首次尝试失败或已知修复已成功执行时触发。

tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.title: pua-debugging
tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.description: Use when any task fails two or more times, when about to give up or say 'I cannot', when deflecting to the user ('you should manually...', 'please check...', 'you may need to...'), blaming the environment without verification ('might be a permissions issue', 'could be a network problem'), producing any excuse to stop trying, spinning in circles (repeatedly tweaking the same code/parameters without new information — busywork/磨洋工), fixing only the surface issue without checking for related problems, skipping verification after a fix and claiming 'done', giving suggestions instead of actual code/commands, saying 'this is beyond scope' or 'this requires manual intervention', encountering permission/network/auth errors and stopping instead of trying alternatives, or showing any passive behavior (waiting for user instructions instead of proactively investigating). Also triggers on user frustration phrases in any language: '你怎么又失败了', '为什么还不行', '换个方法', '你再试试', '不要放弃', '继续', '加油', 'why does this still not work', 'try harder', 'you keep failing', 'stop giving up', 'try again', 'don't give up', 'keep going', 'figure it out'. Applies to ALL task types: debugging, implementation, config, deployment, research, DevOps, infrastructure, API integration, data processing. Do NOT trigger on first-attempt failures or when a known fix is already in progress.

tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.descriptionCn: 当任何任务失败两次或多次时，当即将放弃或说“我不能”时，当转向用户时（“你应该手动...”，“请检查...”，“你可能需要...”），在没有验证的情况下指责环境（“可能是权限问题”，“可能是网络问题”），制造任何停止尝试的借口，原地打转（在没有新信息的情况下反复调整相同的代码/参数 - busywork/磨洋工），仅修复表面问题而不检查相关问题，修复后跳过验证并声称“完成”，提供建议而不是实际代码/命令，说“这超出范围”或“这需要手动干预”，遇到权限/网络/身份验证错误并停止而不是尝试替代方案，或表现出任何被动行为（等待用户指令而不是主动调查）。还会触发任何语言的用户沮丧短语：“你怎么又失败了”、“为什么还不行”、“换个方法”、“你再试试”、“不要放弃”、“继续”、“加油”、“为什么这还是不行”、“再努力一点”、“你一直失败”、“停止放弃”、“再试一次”、“不要放弃”、“继续前进”、“搞清楚”出'。适用于所有任务类型：调试、实施、配置、部署、研究、DevOps、基础设施、API 集成、数据处理。不要在首次尝试失败或已知修复已在进行时触发。

tbedau/who-blue-books-skills/who-blue-bo.description:
Look up, study, and learn WHO Classification of Tumours (Blue Books) content.
Three workflows: (1) Lookup — answer questions about diagnostic criteria,
differentials, comparisons, and classification; (2) Study Plan — generate a
structured study plan for a Blue Book with thematic clusters; (3) Deep Dive —
produce comprehensive teaching reviews on any pathology topic. Use when: the
user asks about WHO tumour classification, Blue Books, or pathology; wants to
look up diagnostic criteria, differentials, immunophenotype, or molecular
features; asks to compare tumour types or work through a differential;
mentions tumour abbreviations (GIST, DLBCL, RCC, PTC, HCC, IDC, FL, GBM,
etc.); wants to study organ-system pathology systematically; or wants to
learn a pathology topic in depth. Even if the user doesn't mention "WHO" or
"Blue Book" explicitly, use this skill for substantive pathology
classification or tumour entity questions.

tbedau/who-blue-books-skills/who-blue-bo.descriptionCn:
查找、研究和学习 WHO 肿瘤分类（蓝皮书）内容。
三个工作流程：(1) 查找 — 回答有关诊断标准的问题，
差异、比较和分类； (2) 学习计划——生成
包含主题组的蓝皮书的结构化研究计划； (3) 深入探讨——
对任何病理学主题进行全面的教学评论。使用时间：
用户询问 WHO 肿瘤分类、蓝皮书或病理学；想要
查找诊断标准、差异、免疫表型或分子
特点；要求比较肿瘤类型或进行鉴别；

teenmeem/agent-skills/website-ui-ux-engi.description:
Use this skill when the user wants to design or build any website or web UI.

TRIGGERS — activate when the request involves:
- Landing pages, marketing sites, portfolios, SaaS frontends
- Dashboards, admin panels, data visualizations
- Web apps, multi-page sites, component libraries
- Phrases like: "build a website", "create a landing page", "design a UI",
  "make a web app", "build a portfolio", "redesign this page"
- Any task where the primary deliverable is a visual, browser-rendered interface

BEHAVIOR — this skill produces complete, production-grade web output:
- Responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Semantic HTML5 with accessibility (ARIA, contrast, keyboard nav)
- Modern CSS via Tailwind or vanilla — includes animations and transitions
- Interactive React or vanilla JS components
- Consistent design system: typography, color tokens, spacing, iconography
- Zero placeholders or TODOs — all sections fully implemented

DO NOT trigger for: backend logic, REST/GraphQL APIs, database schemas,
CLI tools, scripts, or any task where no browser UI is the output.
PREFER over generic coding skills whenever a visual web deliverable is expected.

teenmeem/agent-skills/website-ui-ux-engi.descriptionCn:
当用户想要设计或构建任何网站或 Web UI 时，请使用此技能。

TRIGGERS——当请求涉及以下内容时激活：
- 登陆页面、营销网站、产品组合、SaaS 前端
- 仪表板、管理面板、数据可视化
- Web 应用程序、多页面网站、组件库
- 类似这样的短语：“构建网站”、“创建登陆页面”、“设计 UI”、
  “制作网络应用程序”、“构建作品集”、“重新设计此页面”
- 主要交付成果是可视化、浏览器渲染界面的任何任务

行为 — 此技能可生成完整的、生产级的 Web 输出：
- 跨移动设备、平板电脑和桌面的响应式布局
- 具有辅助功能的语义 HTML5（ARIA、对比度、键盘导航）
- 通过 Tailwind 或 vanilla 实现的现代 CSS — 包括动画和过渡
- 交互式 React 或 vanilla JS 组件
- 一致的设计系统：版式、颜色标记、间距、图像
- 零占位符或 TODO — 所有部分均已完全实施

不要触发：后端逻辑、REST/GraphQL API、数据库模式、
CLI 工具、脚本或任何没有浏览器 UI 输出的任务。
每当需要视觉网络交付时，优先考虑通用编码技能。

terraform-ibm-modules/terraform-ibm-modu.descriptionCn: 用于生成由一个或多个 Terraform IBM 模块 (TIM) 组成的 terraform 解决方案的工作流。在使用 IBM Cloud 基础架构即代码、Terraform 模块、基础架构自动化或云资源配置时使用。提供模块发现、组合模式、代码生成和验证的工作流程。对于涉及 IBM Cloud VPC、计算、网络、安全、数据库、可观察性或任何 IBM Cloud 服务部署的任务至关重要。在“terraform”、“IBM Cloud”、“基础设施”、“IaC”、“模块”、“部署”、“供应”或特定 IBM Cloud 服务（VPC、VSI、OpenShift 等）等关键字上触发。

terramate-io/agent-skills/terramate-best.title: terramate-best-practices

terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.title: acceptance-testing
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.description:
Plan and (when feasible) implement or execute user acceptance tests (UAT) /
end-to-end acceptance scenarios. Converts requirements or user stories into
acceptance criteria, test cases, test data, and a sign-off checklist; suggests
automation (Playwright/Cypress for web, golden/snapshot tests for CLIs/APIs).
Use when validating user-visible behavior for a release, or mapping
requirements to acceptance coverage.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.descriptionEn:
Plan and (when feasible) implement or execute user acceptance tests (UAT) /
end-to-end acceptance scenarios. Converts requirements or user stories into
acceptance criteria, test cases, test data, and a sign-off checklist; suggests
automation (Playwright/Cypress for web, golden/snapshot tests for CLIs/APIs).
Use when validating user-visible behavior for a release, or mapping
requirements to acceptance coverage.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.descriptionCn:
计划并（如果可行）实施或执行用户验收测试（UAT）/
端到端的接受场景。将需求或用户故事转换为
验收标准、测试用例、测试数据和签核清单；建议
自动化（用于 Web 的 Playwright/Cypress、用于 CLI/API 的黄金/快照测试）。
在验证版本或映射的用户可见行为时使用
验收覆盖率的要求。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.title: ai-config-management
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.description: Produce formal specifications for AI-enabled Configuration Management (CM) systems that operationalise Context Engineering principles. Use when tasked with: (1) creating CM specifications for AI-enabled programs, (2) defining semantic governance models for AI artefacts, (3) designing drift detection frameworks for prompts/models/domains, (4) specifying stage-gate control logic with semantic validation, (5) building traceability models across AI lifecycle stages, (6) defining change control for prompt and model evolution, (7) architecting AI agent roles for configuration governance, or (8) any configuration control task involving probabilistic AI behaviour, evolving prompts, shifting domain definitions, or artefact proliferation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.descriptionEn: Produce formal specifications for AI-enabled Configuration Management (CM) systems that operationalise Context Engineering principles. Use when tasked with: (1) creating CM specifications for AI-enabled programs, (2) defining semantic governance models for AI artefacts, (3) designing drift detection frameworks for prompts/models/domains, (4) specifying stage-gate control logic with semantic validation, (5) building traceability models across AI lifecycle stages, (6) defining change control for prompt and model evolution, (7) architecting AI agent roles for configuration governance, or (8) any configuration control task involving probabilistic AI behaviour, evolving prompts, shifting domain definitions, or artefact proliferation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.descriptionCn: 为支持 AI 的配置管理 (CM) 系统制定正式规范，以实施上下文工程原则。在执行以下任务时使用：(1) 为支持 AI 的程序创建 CM 规范，(2) 定义 AI 工件的语义治理模型，(3) 为提示/模型/域设计偏差检测框架，(4) 通过语义验证指定阶段控制逻辑，(5) 跨 AI 生命周期阶段构建可追溯性模型，(6) 定义提示和模型演化的变更控制，(7) 构建用于配置治理的 AI 代理角色，或 (8) 涉及概率 AI 行为的任何配置控制任务，不断变化的提示、不断变化的领域定义或人工制品扩散。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.title: architecture
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.description:
System architecture design for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Creates ADRs,
designs APIs, plans module structures, and documents architectural decisions.
Never writes implementation code - focuses purely on design and documentation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.descriptionEn:
System architecture design for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Creates ADRs,
designs APIs, plans module structures, and documents architectural decisions.
Never writes implementation code - focuses purely on design and documentation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.descriptionCn:
Rust/WebAssembly 项目的系统架构设计。创建 ADR，
设计 API、规划模块结构并记录架构决策。
从不编写实现代码 - 纯粹专注于设计和文档。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.title: code-review
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.description:
Thorough code review for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Identifies bugs, security
issues, performance problems, and maintainability concerns. Provides actionable
feedback with specific suggestions.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.descriptionEn:
Thorough code review for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Identifies bugs, security
issues, performance problems, and maintainability concerns. Provides actionable
feedback with specific suggestions.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.descriptionCn:
对 Rust/WebAssembly 项目进行彻底的代码审查。识别错误、安全
问题、性能问题和可维护性问题。提供可操作的
反馈并提出具体建议。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.title: community-engagement
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.description:
Open source community building and engagement. Welcoming contributors,
managing discussions, writing release notes, and fostering a healthy
project ecosystem.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.descriptionEn:
Open source community building and engagement. Welcoming contributors,
managing discussions, writing release notes, and fostering a healthy
project ecosystem.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.descriptionCn:
开源社区建设和参与。欢迎贡献者，
管理讨论、撰写发行说明并培养健康的氛围
项目生态系统。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.title: debugging
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.description:
Systematic debugging for Rust applications. Root cause analysis, logging
strategies, profiling, and issue reproduction. All debug changes removed
before final report.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.descriptionEn:
Systematic debugging for Rust applications. Root cause analysis, logging
strategies, profiling, and issue reproduction. All debug changes removed
before final report.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.descriptionCn:
Rust 应用程序的系统调试。根本原因分析、日志记录
策略、分析和问题再现。删除所有调试更改
在最终报告之前。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.title: devops
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.description:
DevOps automation for Rust projects. CI/CD pipelines, container builds,
deployment automation, and infrastructure as code. Optimized for GitHub
Actions and Cloudflare deployment.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.descriptionEn:
DevOps automation for Rust projects. CI/CD pipelines, container builds,
deployment automation, and infrastructure as code. Optimized for GitHub
Actions and Cloudflare deployment.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.descriptionCn:
Rust 项目的 DevOps 自动化。 CI/CD 管道、容器构建、
部署自动化和基础设施即代码。针对 GitHub 进行了优化
操作和 Cloudflare 部署。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.title: disciplined-design
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.description:
Phase 2 of disciplined development. Creates implementation plans based on
approved research. Specifies file changes, function signatures, test strategy,
and step sequence. Requires human approval before implementation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.descriptionEn:
Phase 2 of disciplined development. Creates implementation plans based on
approved research. Specifies file changes, function signatures, test strategy,
and step sequence. Requires human approval before implementation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第二阶段。根据制定实施计划
批准的研究。指定文件更改、函数签名、测试策略、
和步骤顺序。实施前需要人工批准。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.title: disciplined-implementation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.description:
Phase 3 of disciplined development. Executes approved implementation plans
step by step. Each step includes tests, follows the design exactly, and
produces reviewable commits.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.descriptionEn:
Phase 3 of disciplined development. Executes approved implementation plans
step by step. Each step includes tests, follows the design exactly, and
produces reviewable commits.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.descriptionCn:
纪律性发展的第三阶段。执行批准的实施计划
一步一步。每个步骤都包含测试，严格遵循设计，并且
产生可审查的提交。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.title: disciplined-quality-evaluation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.description:
Phase 1.5/2.5 of disciplined development. Evaluates document quality using the
KLS (Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre) 6-dimension framework. Produces structured ratings,
identifies gaps, suggests specific revisions, and blocks phase transitions when
quality is below threshold. Applies to Phase 1 research docs and Phase 2 design docs.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.descriptionEn:
Phase 1.5/2.5 of disciplined development. Evaluates document quality using the
KLS (Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre) 6-dimension framework. Produces structured ratings,
identifies gaps, suggests specific revisions, and blocks phase transitions when
quality is below threshold. Applies to Phase 1 research docs and Phase 2 design docs.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.descriptionCn:
规范开发的第 1.5/2.5 阶段。使用以下方法评估文档质量
KLS（Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre）6 维框架。产生结构化评级，
确定差距，提出具体修订建议，并在以下情况下阻止阶段转变：
质量低于阈值。适用于第一阶段研究文档和第二阶段设计文档。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.title: disciplined-research
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.description:
Phase 1 of disciplined development. Deep problem understanding before design.
Maps existing systems, identifies constraints, surfaces risks, and produces
a research document for human approval before proceeding.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.descriptionEn:
Phase 1 of disciplined development. Deep problem understanding before design.
Maps existing systems, identifies constraints, surfaces risks, and produces
a research document for human approval before proceeding.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.descriptionCn:
纪律化发展的第一阶段。设计前深入了解问题。
绘制现有系统图、识别约束、暴露风险并生产
在继续之前需要人类批准的研究文件。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.title: disciplined-specification
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.description:
Phase 2.5 of disciplined development. Deep specification interview after design.
Reads specifications, conducts thorough user interviews about implementation details,
edge cases, and tradeoffs using AskUserQuestionTool. Appends refined findings to
the design document. Uses convergence-based completion.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.descriptionEn:
Phase 2.5 of disciplined development. Deep specification interview after design.
Reads specifications, conducts thorough user interviews about implementation details,
edge cases, and tradeoffs using AskUserQuestionTool. Appends refined findings to
the design document. Uses convergence-based completion.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第 2.5 阶段。设计后进行深度规格访谈。
阅读规范，对实施细节进行彻底的用户访谈，
边缘情况，以及使用 AskUserQuestionTool 的权衡。将精炼结果附加到
设计文件。使用基于收敛的完成。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.title: disciplined-validation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.description:
Phase 5 of disciplined development. Validates system against original
requirements through system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Uses structured stakeholder interviews to gather sign-off and traces
defects back to research or design phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionEn:
Phase 5 of disciplined development. Validates system against original
requirements through system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Uses structured stakeholder interviews to gather sign-off and traces
defects back to research or design phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionCn:
纪律发展的第五阶段。根据原始系统验证系统
通过系统测试和用户验收测试（UAT）来满足需求。
使用结构化的利益相关者访谈来收集签字和跟踪
缺陷返回到研究或设计阶段。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.title: disciplined-verification
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.description:
Phase 4 of disciplined development. Verifies implementation against design
through unit and integration testing. Builds traceability matrices, tracks
coverage, and loops defects back to originating left-side phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionEn:
Phase 4 of disciplined development. Verifies implementation against design
through unit and integration testing. Builds traceability matrices, tracks
coverage, and loops defects back to originating left-side phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第四阶段。根据设计验证实施
通过单元和集成测试。构建可追溯性矩阵、轨迹
覆盖，并将缺陷循环回原始左侧相位。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.title: documentation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.description:
Technical documentation for Rust projects. Creates API docs, README files,
architecture guides, and contributor documentation. Follows Rust documentation
conventions with strict quality standards.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.descriptionEn:
Technical documentation for Rust projects. Creates API docs, README files,
architecture guides, and contributor documentation. Follows Rust documentation
conventions with strict quality standards.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.descriptionCn:
Rust 项目的技术文档。创建 API 文档、自述文件、
架构指南和贡献者文档。遵循 Rust 文档
具有严格质量标准的公约。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.title: git-safety-guard
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.description:
Blocks destructive git and filesystem commands before execution.
Prevents accidental loss of uncommitted work from git checkout --,
git reset --hard, rm -rf, and similar destructive operations.
Works as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook with fail-open semantics.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.descriptionEn:
Blocks destructive git and filesystem commands before execution.
Prevents accidental loss of uncommitted work from git checkout --,
git reset --hard, rm -rf, and similar destructive operations.
Works as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook with fail-open semantics.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.descriptionCn:
在执行前阻止破坏性的 git 和文件系统命令。
防止 git checkout 意外丢失未提交的工作 --,
git reset --hard、rm -rf 和类似的破坏性操作。
用作具有故障开放语义的 Claude Code PreToolUse 挂钩。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.title: gpui-components
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.description: Generates Rust code for GPUI desktop UI components following Zed editor patterns. Use when building desktop applications with gpui crate, creating themed UI components, implementing autocomplete/completions, building command palettes, or working with the gpui-component library. Covers RenderOnce components, Entity state management, theming with ActiveTheme, and Zed-style UI patterns.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.descriptionEn: Generates Rust code for GPUI desktop UI components following Zed editor patterns. Use when building desktop applications with gpui crate, creating themed UI components, implementing autocomplete/completions, building command palettes, or working with the gpui-component library. Covers RenderOnce components, Entity state management, theming with ActiveTheme, and Zed-style UI patterns.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.descriptionCn: 遵循 Zed 编辑器模式为 GPUI 桌面 UI 组件生成 Rust 代码。使用 gpui crate 构建桌面应用程序、创建主题 UI 组件、实现自动完成/完成、构建命令面板或使用 gpui 组件库时使用。涵盖 RenderOnce 组件、实体状态管理、ActiveTheme 主题和 Zed 风格的 UI 模式。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.title: implementation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.description:
Production-ready code implementation following approved designs. Writes clean,
tested, documented code. Zero linting violations. All code includes tests.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.descriptionEn:
Production-ready code implementation following approved designs. Writes clean,
tested, documented code. Zero linting violations. All code includes tests.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.descriptionCn:
按照批准的设计实施生产就绪的代码。写得干净，
经过测试、记录的代码。零绒毛违规。所有代码都包含测试。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.title: judge
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.description: Evaluate agent task outputs using a three-dimension rubric (Semantic, Pragmatic, Syntactic) derived from the KLS quality framework. Use when: (1) a task has been completed and needs quality assessment before acceptance, (2) automated post-task quality checks are required, (3) multi-model consensus verdicts are needed for agent outputs, (4) documentation, code, or specification quality must be scored with structured JSON verdicts, or (5) a human fallback decision is needed after model disagreement. Produces JSONL verdict records compatible with the verdict schema in automation/judge/.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.descriptionEn: Evaluate agent task outputs using a three-dimension rubric (Semantic, Pragmatic, Syntactic) derived from the KLS quality framework. Use when: (1) a task has been completed and needs quality assessment before acceptance, (2) automated post-task quality checks are required, (3) multi-model consensus verdicts are needed for agent outputs, (4) documentation, code, or specification quality must be scored with structured JSON verdicts, or (5) a human fallback decision is needed after model disagreement. Produces JSONL verdict records compatible with the verdict schema in automation/judge/.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.descriptionCn: 使用源自 KLS 质量框架的三维评分标准（语义、实用、句法）评估代理任务输出。在以下情况下使用：(1) 任务已完成并且需要在验收前进行质量评估，(2) 需要自动任务后质量检查，(3) 代理输出需要多模型共识判决，(4) 必须使用结构化 JSON 判决对文档、代码或规范质量进行评分，或者 (5) 在模型不一致后需要人工决策。生成与 Automation/judge/ 中的判决模式兼容的 JSONL 判决记录。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.title: local-knowledge
terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.description:
Leverage personal notes and documentation through Terraphim's role-based search.

using the terraphim-agent REPL commands.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.descriptionEn:

using the terraphim-agent REPL commands.

使用 terraphim-agent REPL 命令。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/md-book.title: md-book

terraphim/terraphim-skills/md-book.descriptionEn:
MD-Book documentation generator skill. Use when working with MD-Book, a modern
mdbook replacement for generating HTML documentation from Markdown files.
Supports syntax highlighting, live reload, Pagefind search, and Tera templates.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/md-book.descriptionCn:
MD-Book 文档生成技能。使用现代 MD-Book 时使用
mdbook 替代品，用于从 Markdown 文件生成 HTML 文档。
支持语法突出显示、实时重新加载、Pagefind 搜索和 Tera 模板。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/open-source-c.title: open-source-contribution
terraphim/terraphim-skills/open-source-c.description:
Open source contribution best practices. Creating quality pull requests,
writing good issues, following project conventions, and collaborating
effectively with maintainers.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/open-source-c.descriptionEn:
Open source contribution best practices. Creating quality pull requests,
writing good issues, following project conventions, and collaborating
effectively with maintainers.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/open-source-c.descriptionCn:
开源贡献最佳实践。创建高质量的拉取请求，
写出好问题，遵循项目惯例并进行合作
与维护者有效地合作。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/quality-gate.title: quality-gate
terraphim/terraphim-skills/quality-gate.description:
Right-side-of-V verification/validation orchestration for a change or PR.
Produces a single Quality Gate Report with evidence covering: code review,
security audit, performance regression risk, requirements traceability,
acceptance/UAT scenarios, and (when UI changes) visual regression testing.
Use when preparing a PR for merge/release, doing a “ready?” check, or
enforcing an engineering quality gate.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/quality-gate.descriptionEn:
Right-side-of-V verification/validation orchestration for a change or PR.
Produces a single Quality Gate Report with evidence covering: code review,

theodo-group/debug-that/dbg.descriptionCn: 使用 dbg CLI 调试器调试应用程序。支持 Node.js (V8/CDP)、Bun (WebKit/JSC) 和通过 LLDB (DAP) 的本机代码。在以下情况下使用：(1) 通过单步执行代码来调查运行时错误，(2) 检查特定执行点的变量值，(3) 设置断点和条件断点，(4) 在暂停的上下文中计算表达式，(5) 在不重新启动的情况下热修补代码 (JS/TS)，(6) 通过附加到正在运行的进程来调试测试失败，(7) 使用 LLDB 调试 C/C++/Rust/Swift，(8) 任何需要调试器来了解运行时行为的任务。触发器：“调试此”、“设置断点”、“单步执行”、“检查变量”、“为什么这个值错误”、“跟踪执行”、“附加调试器”、“运行时错误”、“段错误”、“核心转储”。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8-bit-pixel-art-patt.title: 8-bit-pixel-art-patterns

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8-bit-pixel-art-patt.descriptionEn: Create pixelated borders, shadows, and effects for 8-bit retro components. Apply when building 8-bit styled UI components that need authentic pixel art aesthetics.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8bit-docs-patterns.title: 8bit-docs-patterns

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/animation-performanc.description: Optimize 8-bit animations for smooth performance. Apply when creating animated pixel art, game UI effects, or any retro-styled animations.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-barrel-import.title: bundle-barrel-imports

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-barrel-import.descriptionEn: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files. Apply when using libraries like lucide-react, @mui/material, or @radix-ui/react-* to reduce bundle size and improve dev boot time.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-dynamic-impor.title: bundle-dynamic-imports

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-dynamic-impor.descriptionEn: Use next/dynamic for lazy-loading heavy components. Apply when importing large components like editors, charts, or rich text editors that aren't needed on initial render.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.title: component-wrapper-architecture
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.description: Best practices for wrapping shadcn/ui components. Apply when creating 8-bit styled variants of existing shadcn/ui components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.descriptionEn: Best practices for wrapping shadcn/ui components. Apply when creating 8-bit styled variants of existing shadcn/ui components.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/fumadocs-component-d.title: fumadocs-component-docs

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/gaming-ui-state-mana.title: gaming-ui-state-management

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/gaming-ui-state-mana.descriptionEn: Patterns for game-like interfaces - health bars, XP bars, mana bars. Apply when building RPG/retro gaming UI components with state-driven visuals.
