theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.title: js-early-exit
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.description: Use early returns to avoid unnecessary computation in loops and functions. Apply when processing arrays, validating input, or checking multiple conditions where the result can be determined before all iterations complete.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.descriptionEn: Use early returns to avoid unnecessary computation in loops and functions. Apply when processing arrays, validating input, or checking multiple conditions where the result can be determined before all iterations complete.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.descriptionCn: 使用早期返回以避免循环和函数中不必要的计算。在处理数组、验证输入或检查多个条件时应用，在所有迭代完成之前可以确定结果。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.title: js-hoist-regexp
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.description: Hoist RegExp creation outside render or memoize with useMemo(). Apply when using regular expressions in React components or frequently called functions.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.descriptionEn: Hoist RegExp creation outside render or memoize with useMemo(). Apply when using regular expressions in React components or frequently called functions.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.descriptionCn: 使用 useMemo() 在渲染或记忆之外提升正则表达式的创建。当在 React 组件或频繁调用的函数中使用正则表达式时适用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.title: js-set-map-lookups
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.description: Use Set and Map for O(1) membership lookups instead of array.includes(). Apply when checking membership repeatedly or performing frequent lookups against a collection.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.descriptionEn: Use Set and Map for O(1) membership lookups instead of array.includes(). Apply when checking membership repeatedly or performing frequent lookups against a collection.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.descriptionCn: 使用 Set 和 Map 进行 O(1) 成员资格查找，而不是 array.includes()。在重复检查成员资格或对集合执行频繁查找时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.title: js-tosorted-immutable
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.description: Use toSorted() instead of sort() to avoid mutating arrays. Apply when sorting arrays that are React props, state, or otherwise shared/referenced elsewhere.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.descriptionEn: Use toSorted() instead of sort() to avoid mutating arrays. Apply when sorting arrays that are React props, state, or otherwise shared/referenced elsewhere.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.descriptionCn: 使用 toSorted() 而不是 sort() 以避免数组发生变化。在对 React props、state 或其他地方共享/引用的数组进行排序时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/registry-component-p.title: registry-component-patterns
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/registry-component-p.description: Register components in registry.json for shadcn/ui add command. Apply when adding new 8-bit components to the component library.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.title: rendering-animate-svg
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.description: Wrap animated SVG elements in a div to enable hardware acceleration. Apply when animating SVG icons or elements, especially in 8-bit retro components with pixel art animations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.descriptionEn: Wrap animated SVG elements in a div to enable hardware acceleration. Apply when animating SVG icons or elements, especially in 8-bit retro components with pixel art animations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.descriptionCn: 将动画 SVG 元素包裹在 div 中以启用硬件加速。在对 SVG 图标或元素进行动画处理时应用，尤其是在具有像素艺术动画的 8 位复古组件中。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.title: rendering-conditional-render
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.description: Use explicit ternary operators instead of && for conditional rendering. Apply when rendering values that could be 0, NaN, or other falsy values that might render unexpectedly.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.descriptionEn: Use explicit ternary operators instead of && for conditional rendering. Apply when rendering values that could be 0, NaN, or other falsy values that might render unexpectedly.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.descriptionCn: 使用显式三元运算符而不是 && 进行条件渲染。当呈现可能为 0、NaN 或其他可能意外呈现的虚假值时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.title: rendering-hoist-jsx
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.description: Extract static JSX elements outside components to avoid re-creation on every render. Apply when rendering static elements repeatedly or in lists.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.descriptionEn: Extract static JSX elements outside components to avoid re-creation on every render. Apply when rendering static elements repeatedly or in lists.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.descriptionCn: 从组件外部提取静态 JSX 元素，以避免在每次渲染时重新创建。在重复渲染静态元素或在列表中渲染时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.title: rerender-functional-setstate
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.description: Use functional setState updates to prevent stale closures and unnecessary callback recreations. Apply when updating state based on the current state value in React components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.descriptionEn: Use functional setState updates to prevent stale closures and unnecessary callback recreations. Apply when updating state based on the current state value in React components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.descriptionCn: 使用功能性 setState 更新来防止陈旧的闭包和不必要的回调重新创建。当根据 React 组件中的当前状态值更新状态时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.title: rerender-lazy-state
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.description: Use lazy state initialization with useState function form. Apply when computing expensive initial values like building search indexes, parsing JSON, or complex calculations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.descriptionEn: Use lazy state initialization with useState function form. Apply when computing expensive initial values like building search indexes, parsing JSON, or complex calculations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.descriptionCn: 通过 useState 函数形式使用惰性状态初始化。在计算昂贵的初始值（例如构建搜索索引、解析 JSON 或复杂计算）时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.title: rerender-memo
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.description: Extract expensive work into memoized components with React.memo. Apply when components perform expensive computations that can be skipped when props haven't changed.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.descriptionEn: Extract expensive work into memoized components with React.memo. Apply when components perform expensive computations that can be skipped when props haven't changed.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.descriptionCn: 使用 React.memo 将昂贵的工作提取到记忆组件中。当组件执行昂贵的计算时应用，当 props 没有改变时可以跳过这些计算。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/retro-css-architectu.title: retro-css-architecture

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/retro-css-architectu.descriptionCn: 使用自定义属性、像素字体和响应式像素艺术来组织 8 位 CSS。在创建或修改复古风格的组件及其 CSS 时应用。

tighten724-hub/openclaw-troubleshooter/o.description:
OpenClaw故障排除技能。当用户遇到以下问题时使用：
1. Gateway无法启动、无法连接、无响应
2. 渠道连接问题（WhatsApp、Telegram、Discord等）
3. 模型配置问题（API Key、模型切换失败）
4. Dashboard/Control UI打不开、连接失败
5. 会话问题（会话丢失、无法创建新会话）
6. 配置错误（配置文件错误）
7. 节点问题（配对失败、工具调用失败）
8. 浏览器工具问题
9. Cron/心跳任务不执行
10. 安装/更新问题

触发关键词：Gateway、启动、连接、报错、问题、故障、无法、失败、错误、Dashboard、UI、渠道、模型、会话、节点、浏览器、Cron、心跳、安装、更新

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.title: mdanalysis
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.description: Comprehensive guide for MDAnalysis - the Python library for analyzing molecular dynamics trajectories. Use for trajectory loading, RMSD/RMSF calculations, distance/angle/dihedral analysis, atom selections, hydrogen bonds, solvent accessible surface area, protein structure analysis, membrane analysis, and integration with Biopython. Essential for MD simulation analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for MDAnalysis - the Python library for analyzing molecular dynamics trajectories. Use for trajectory loading, RMSD/RMSF calculations, distance/angle/dihedral analysis, atom selections, hydrogen bonds, solvent accessible surface area, protein structure analysis, membrane analysis, and integration with Biopython. Essential for MD simulation analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.descriptionCn: MDAnalysis 的综合指南 - 用于分析分子动力学轨迹的 Python 库。用于轨迹加载、RMSD/RMSF 计算、距离/角度/二面角分析、原子选择、氢键、溶剂可及表面积、蛋白质结构分析、膜分析以及与 Biopython 集成。 MD 模拟分析必不可少。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.title: mne
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.description: Open-source Python package for exploring, visualizing, and analyzing human neurophysiological data including EEG, MEG, sEEG, and ECoG.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.descriptionEn: Open-source Python package for exploring, visualizing, and analyzing human neurophysiological data including EEG, MEG, sEEG, and ECoG.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.descriptionCn: 用于探索、可视化和分析人类神经生理学数据（包括 EEG、MEG、sEEG 和 ECoG）的开源 Python 包。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.title: networkx
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.description: Python package for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks. Supports various graph types (Directed, Undirected, Multigraphs) and features a vast library of standard graph algorithms. Use for network analysis, graph theory, social network analysis, biological networks, infrastructure networks, path finding, centrality measures, community detection, graph algorithms, shortest paths, PageRank, connectivity analysis, and routing optimization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.descriptionEn: Python package for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks. Supports various graph types (Directed, Undirected, Multigraphs) and features a vast library of standard graph algorithms. Use for network analysis, graph theory, social network analysis, biological networks, infrastructure networks, path finding, centrality measures, community detection, graph algorithms, shortest paths, PageRank, connectivity analysis, and routing optimization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.descriptionCn: 用于创建、操作和研究复杂网络的结构、动力学和功能的 Python 包。支持各种图类型（有向图、无向图、多重图），并具有庞大的标准图算法库。用于网络分析、图论、社交网络分析、生物网络、基础设施网络、路径查找、中心性度量、社区检测、图算法、最短路径、PageRank、连接性分析和路由优化。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.title: numba
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.description: A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler for Python that translates a subset of Python and NumPy code into fast machine code. Developed by Anaconda, Inc. Highly effective for accelerating loops, custom mathematical functions, and complex numerical algorithms. Use for @njit, @vectorize, prange, cuda.jit, numba.typed, JIT compilation, parallel loops, GPU acceleration with CUDA, Monte Carlo simulations, numerical algorithms, and high-performance Python computing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.descriptionEn: A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler for Python that translates a subset of Python and NumPy code into fast machine code. Developed by Anaconda, Inc. Highly effective for accelerating loops, custom mathematical functions, and complex numerical algorithms. Use for @njit, @vectorize, prange, cuda.jit, numba.typed, JIT compilation, parallel loops, GPU acceleration with CUDA, Monte Carlo simulations, numerical algorithms, and high-performance Python computing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.descriptionCn: Python 的即时 (JIT) 编译器，可将 Python 和 NumPy 代码的子集转换为快速机器代码。由 Anaconda, Inc. 开发。对于加速循环、自定义数学函数和复杂的数值算法非常有效。用于@njit、@vectorize、prange、cuda.jit、numba.typed、JIT 编译、并行循环、CUDA 的 GPU 加速、蒙特卡罗模拟、数值算法和高性能 Python 计算。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.title: numpy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.description: Comprehensive guide for NumPy - the fundamental package for scientific computing in Python. Use for array operations, linear algebra, random number generation, Fourier transforms, mathematical functions, and high-performance numerical computing. Foundation for SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and all scientific Python.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for NumPy - the fundamental package for scientific computing in Python. Use for array operations, linear algebra, random number generation, Fourier transforms, mathematical functions, and high-performance numerical computing. Foundation for SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and all scientific Python.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.descriptionCn: NumPy 综合指南 - Python 中科学计算的基础包。用于数组运算、线性代数、随机数生成、傅里叶变换、数学函数和高性能数值计算。 SciPy、pandas、scikit-learn 和所有科学 Python 的基础。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.title: numpy-low-level
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.description: Advanced sub-skill for NumPy focused on internal memory management, stride manipulation, structured arrays, and interfacing with C/Cython. Covers zero-copy operations and SIMD vectorization principles.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for NumPy focused on internal memory management, stride manipulation, structured arrays, and interfacing with C/Cython. Covers zero-copy operations and SIMD vectorization principles.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.descriptionCn: NumPy 的高级子技能侧重于内部内存管理、跨步操作、结构化数组以及与 C/Cython 的接口。涵盖零拷贝操作和 SIMD 矢量化原理。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.title: openbabel
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.description: A chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data. Supports over 110 formats and provides tools for conversion, 3D structure generation, molecular searching (SMARTS), and force field calculations. Use for chemical file format conversion (SDF, PDB, SMILES, CIF, Gaussian), 3D coordinate generation from 2D structures, substructure searching with SMARTS patterns, molecular docking preparation, force field minimizations (UFF, GAFF, MMFF94), molecular fingerprints and Tanimoto coefficients, and batch processing of chemical databases.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.descriptionEn: A chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data. Supports over 110 formats and provides tools for conversion, 3D structure generation, molecular searching (SMARTS), and force field calculations. Use for chemical file format conversion (SDF, PDB, SMILES, CIF, Gaussian), 3D coordinate generation from 2D structures, substructure searching with SMARTS patterns, molecular docking preparation, force field minimizations (UFF, GAFF, MMFF94), molecular fingerprints and Tanimoto coefficients, and batch processing of chemical databases.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.descriptionCn: 一个化学工具箱，旨在使用多种化学数据语言。支持 110 多种格式，并提供转换、3D 结构生成、分子搜索 (SMARTS) 和力场计算工具。用于化学文件格式转换（SDF、PDB、SMILES、CIF、高斯）、从 2D 结构生成 3D 坐标、使用 SMARTS 模式搜索子结构、分子对接准备、力场最小化（UFF、GAFF、MMFF94）、分子指纹和 Tanimoto 系数以及化学数据库的批量处理。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.title: opencv
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.description: Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) for real-time image processing, video analysis, object detection, face recognition, and camera calibration. Use when working with images, videos, cameras, edge detection, contours, feature detection, image transformations, object tracking, optical flow, or any computer vision task.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.descriptionEn: Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) for real-time image processing, video analysis, object detection, face recognition, and camera calibration. Use when working with images, videos, cameras, edge detection, contours, feature detection, image transformations, object tracking, optical flow, or any computer vision task.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.descriptionCn: 开源计算机视觉库 (OpenCV)，用于实时图像处理、视频分析、对象检测、人脸识别和相机校准。在处理图像、视频、相机、边缘检测、轮廓、特征检测、图像转换、对象跟踪、光流或任何计算机视觉任务时使用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.title: ortools
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.description: Google Optimization Tools. An open-source software suite for optimization, specialized in vehicle routing, flows, integer and linear programming, and constraint programming. Features the world-class CP-SAT solver. Use for vehicle routing problems (VRP), scheduling, bin packing, knapsack problems, linear programming (LP), integer programming (MIP), network flows, constraint programming, combinatorial optimization, resource allocation, shift scheduling, job-shop scheduling, and discrete optimization problems.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.descriptionEn: Google Optimization Tools. An open-source software suite for optimization, specialized in vehicle routing, flows, integer and linear programming, and constraint programming. Features the world-class CP-SAT solver. Use for vehicle routing problems (VRP), scheduling, bin packing, knapsack problems, linear programming (LP), integer programming (MIP), network flows, constraint programming, combinatorial optimization, resource allocation, shift scheduling, job-shop scheduling, and discrete optimization problems.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.descriptionCn: 谷歌优化工具。用于优化的开源软件套件，专门用于车辆路径、流程、整数和线性规划以及约束规划。具有世界一流的 CP-SAT 求解器。用于车辆路径问题 (VRP)、调度、装箱、背包问题、线性规划 (LP)、整数规划 (MIP)、网络流、约束规划、组合优化、资源分配、班次调度、作业车间调度和离散优化问题。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.title: pandas-performance
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.description: Advanced sub-skill for pandas focused on memory optimization, execution speed, and handling large-scale datasets (10M+ rows). Covers low-level dtypes, efficient indexing, and vectorization of complex logic.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for pandas focused on memory optimization, execution speed, and handling large-scale datasets (10M+ rows). Covers low-level dtypes, efficient indexing, and vectorization of complex logic.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.descriptionCn: pandas 的高级子技能专注于内存优化、执行速度和处理大规模数据集（10M+ 行）。涵盖低级数据类型、高效索引和复杂逻辑的矢量化。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.title: plotly
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.description: A high-level interactive graphing library for Python. Ideal for web-based visualizations, 3D plots, and complex interactive dashboards. Built on plotly.js, it allows users to zoom, pan, and hover over data points in a browser-based environment. Use for interactive charts, web applications, Jupyter notebooks, 3D data visualization, geographic maps, financial charts, animations, time-series analysis, and building production-ready dashboards with Dash.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.descriptionEn: A high-level interactive graphing library for Python. Ideal for web-based visualizations, 3D plots, and complex interactive dashboards. Built on plotly.js, it allows users to zoom, pan, and hover over data points in a browser-based environment. Use for interactive charts, web applications, Jupyter notebooks, 3D data visualization, geographic maps, financial charts, animations, time-series analysis, and building production-ready dashboards with Dash.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.descriptionCn: Python 的高级交互式图形库。非常适合基于 Web 的可视化、3D 绘图和复杂的交互式仪表板。它基于plotly.js 构建，允许用户在基于浏览器的环境中缩放、平移和悬停在数据点上。用于交互式图表、Web 应用程序、Jupyter 笔记本、3D 数据可视化、地理地图、财务图表、动画、时间序列分析以及使用 Dash 构建生产就绪的仪表板。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.title: polars
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.description: Blazingly fast DataFrame library written in Rust. Features a multi-threaded query engine, lazy evaluation, and efficient memory usage via Apache Arrow. Designed for high-performance data processing on a single machine. Use for large datasets (1GB-100GB+), fast data transformations, Parquet/CSV processing, complex query pipelines, memory-efficient operations, and when speed is critical (10-100x faster than pandas).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.descriptionEn: Blazingly fast DataFrame library written in Rust. Features a multi-threaded query engine, lazy evaluation, and efficient memory usage via Apache Arrow. Designed for high-performance data processing on a single machine. Use for large datasets (1GB-100GB+), fast data transformations, Parquet/CSV processing, complex query pipelines, memory-efficient operations, and when speed is critical (10-100x faster than pandas).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.descriptionCn: 用 Rust 编写的速度极快的 DataFrame 库。具有多线程查询引擎、惰性求值以及通过 Apache Arrow 实现的高效内存使用。专为在单台机器上进行高性能数据处理而设计。用于大型数据集 (1GB-100GB+)、快速数据转换、Parquet/CSV 处理、复杂查询管道、内存高效操作以及速度至关重要的情况（比 pandas 快 10-100 倍）。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.title: prody
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.description: Protein Dynamics, Evolution, and Structure analysis. Specialized in Normal Mode Analysis (NMA) using Anisotropic (ANM) and Gaussian Network Models (GNM). Features tools for structural ensemble analysis, PCA, and co-evolutionary analysis (Evol). Use for protein flexibility prediction, collective motions, structural ensemble comparison, hinge region identification, binding site analysis, MD trajectory filtering, and evolutionary analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.descriptionEn: Protein Dynamics, Evolution, and Structure analysis. Specialized in Normal Mode Analysis (NMA) using Anisotropic (ANM) and Gaussian Network Models (GNM). Features tools for structural ensemble analysis, PCA, and co-evolutionary analysis (Evol). Use for protein flexibility prediction, collective motions, structural ensemble comparison, hinge region identification, binding site analysis, MD trajectory filtering, and evolutionary analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.descriptionCn: 蛋白质动力学、进化和结构分析。专门从事使用各向异性 (ANM) 和高斯网络模型 (GNM) 的正则模态分析 (NMA)。具有用于结构集成分析、PCA 和协同进化分析 (Evol) 的工具。用于蛋白质灵活性预测、集体运动、结构整体比较、铰链区识别、结合位点分析、MD 轨迹过滤和进化分析。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.title: pyomo
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.description: Python Optimization Modeling Objects. A high-level framework for formulating, solving, and analyzing optimization models. Supports Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), and Non-Linear Programming (NLP). Part of the COIN-OR project. Use for mathematical optimization, linear programming, mixed-integer programming, non-linear programming, strategic planning, process engineering, energy systems, supply chain optimization, stochastic programming, and solver integration with IPOPT, SCIP, Gurobi, CPLEX, or GLPK.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.descriptionEn: Python Optimization Modeling Objects. A high-level framework for formulating, solving, and analyzing optimization models. Supports Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), and Non-Linear Programming (NLP). Part of the COIN-OR project. Use for mathematical optimization, linear programming, mixed-integer programming, non-linear programming, strategic planning, process engineering, energy systems, supply chain optimization, stochastic programming, and solver integration with IPOPT, SCIP, Gurobi, CPLEX, or GLPK.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.descriptionCn: Python 优化建模对象。用于制定、求解和分析优化模型的高级框架。支持线性规划 (LP)、混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 和非线性规划 (NLP)。 COIN-OR 项目的一部分。用于数学优化、线性规划、混合整数规划、非线性规划、战略规划、流程工程、能源系统、供应链优化、随机规划以及与 IPOPT、SCIP、Gurobi、CPLEX 或 GLPK 的求解器集成。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.title: pyproj
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.description: Python interface to PROJ (cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library). Handles transformations between different Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) and performs geodetic calculations (distance, area on ellipsoids). Use for coordinate transformations, CRS conversions, geodetic calculations, UTM projections, GPS coordinate conversions, ellipsoidal distance calculations, and spatial reference system operations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.descriptionEn: Python interface to PROJ (cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library). Handles transformations between different Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) and performs geodetic calculations (distance, area on ellipsoids). Use for coordinate transformations, CRS conversions, geodetic calculations, UTM projections, GPS coordinate conversions, ellipsoidal distance calculations, and spatial reference system operations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.descriptionCn: PROJ（制图投影和坐标转换库）的 Python 接口。处理不同坐标参考系 (CRS) 之间的转换并执行大地测量计算（椭圆体上的距离、面积）。用于坐标变换、CRS 转换、大地测量计算、UTM 投影、GPS 坐标转换、椭球距离计算和空间参考系统操作。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.title: pyscf
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.description: Comprehensive guide for PySCF - Python-based Simulations of Chemistry Framework. Use for ab initio quantum chemistry calculations including Hartree-Fock, DFT, MP2, CCSD, geometry optimization, excited states, and molecular properties. Industry-standard library for electronic structure calculations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for PySCF - Python-based Simulations of Chemistry Framework. Use for ab initio quantum chemistry calculations including Hartree-Fock, DFT, MP2, CCSD, geometry optimization, excited states, and molecular properties. Industry-standard library for electronic structure calculations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.descriptionCn: PySCF 综合指南 - 基于 Python 的化学模拟框架。用于从头算量子化学计算，包括 Hartree-Fock、DFT、MP2、CCSD、几何优化、激发态和分子特性。用于电子结构计算的行业标准库。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Leading deep learning framework. Provides Tensors and Dynamic Computational Graphs with strong GPU acceleration. Widely used for research, neural networks, and differentiable programming.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Leading deep learning framework. Provides Tensors and Dynamic Computational Graphs with strong GPU acceleration. Widely used for research, neural networks, and differentiable programming.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionCn: 领先的深度学习框架。提供具有强大GPU加速的张量和动态计算图。广泛用于研究、神经网络和可微分编程。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch-deployment
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on model productionization and deployment. Covers TorchScript (JIT/Tracing), ONNX export, LibTorch (C++ API), and inference optimization (Quantization, Pruning).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on model productionization and deployment. Covers TorchScript (JIT/Tracing), ONNX export, LibTorch (C++ API), and inference optimization (Quantization, Pruning).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionCn: PyTorch 的高级子技能专注于模型生产和部署。涵盖 TorchScript (JIT/Tracing)、ONNX 导出、LibTorch (C++ API) 和推理优化（量化、修剪）。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch-research
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on deep research and production engineering. Covers custom Autograd functions, module hooks, advanced initialization, Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and performance profiling.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on deep research and production engineering. Covers custom Autograd functions, module hooks, advanced initialization, Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and performance profiling.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionCn: PyTorch 的高级子技能专注于深入研究和生产工程。涵盖自定义 Autograd 函数、模块挂钩、高级初始化、分布式数据并行 (DDP) 和性能分析。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.title: qiskit-hardware
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.description: Advanced sub-skill for Qiskit focused on executing circuits on physical quantum processing units (QPUs). Covers IBM Quantum Runtime, error mitigation techniques (TREX, ZNE), hardware-aware transpilation, and low-level pulse control (OpenPulse).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for Qiskit focused on executing circuits on physical quantum processing units (QPUs). Covers IBM Quantum Runtime, error mitigation techniques (TREX, ZNE), hardware-aware transpilation, and low-level pulse control (OpenPulse).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.descriptionCn: Qiskit 的高级子技能专注于在物理量子处理单元 (QPU) 上执行电路。涵盖 IBM Quantum Runtime、错误缓解技术（TREX、ZNE）、硬件感知转译和低​​级脉冲控制 (OpenPulse)。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.title: scikit-image
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.description: A collection of algorithms for image processing in Python. Built on NumPy, SciPy, and Cython. It focuses on scientific image analysis including segmentation, geometric transformations, color space manipulation, analysis, and filtering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionEn: A collection of algorithms for image processing in Python. Built on NumPy, SciPy, and Cython. It focuses on scientific image analysis including segmentation, geometric transformations, color space manipulation, analysis, and filtering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionCn: Python 中图像处理算法的集合。基于 NumPy、SciPy 和 Cython 构建。它专注于科学图像分析，包括分割、几何变换、色彩空间操作、分析和过滤。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.title: scikit-learn
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.description: The industry standard library for machine learning in Python. Provides simple and efficient tools for predictive data analysis, covering classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, model selection, and preprocessing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionEn: The industry standard library for machine learning in Python. Provides simple and efficient tools for predictive data analysis, covering classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, model selection, and preprocessing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionCn: Python 机器学习的行业标准库。为预测数据分析提供简单高效的工具，涵盖分类、回归、聚类、降维、模型选择和预处理。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.title: scikit-video
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.description: Video processing library for scientists. Provides easy access to video files using FFmpeg, motion estimation algorithms, and video quality metrics. Built on NumPy and designed for high-performance research in computer vision and image sequence analysis. Use when working with video files, motion estimation, video quality assessment (VQA), FFmpeg, temporal image data, video codecs, YUV data, or scientific video recordings.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionEn: Video processing library for scientists. Provides easy access to video files using FFmpeg, motion estimation algorithms, and video quality metrics. Built on NumPy and designed for high-performance research in computer vision and image sequence analysis. Use when working with video files, motion estimation, video quality assessment (VQA), FFmpeg, temporal image data, video codecs, YUV data, or scientific video recordings.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionCn: 为科学家提供的视频处理库。使用 FFmpeg、运动估计算法和视频质量指标轻松访问视频文件。基于 NumPy 构建，专为计算机视觉和图像序列分析的高性能研究而设计。在处理视频文件、运动估计、视频质量评估 (VQA)、FFmpeg、时态图像数据、视频编解码器、YUV 数据或科学视频录制时使用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.title: scipy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.description: Comprehensive guide for SciPy - the fundamental library for scientific and technical computing in Python. Use for integration, optimization, interpolation, linear algebra, signal processing, statistics, ODEs, Fourier transforms, and advanced scientific algorithms. Built on NumPy and essential for research and engineering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for SciPy - the fundamental library for scientific and technical computing in Python. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/downtr.title: downtrend-duration-analyzer

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/dual-a.title: dual-axis-skill-reviewer

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.title: earnings-calendar
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.description: This skill retrieves upcoming earnings announcements for US stocks using the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API. Use this when the user requests earnings calendar data, wants to know which companies are reporting earnings in the upcoming week, or needs a weekly earnings review. The skill focuses on mid-cap and above companies (over $2B market cap) that have significant market impact, organizing the data by date and timing in a clean markdown table format. Supports multiple environments (CLI, Desktop, Web) with flexible API key management.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.descriptionCn: 此技能使用 Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API 检索即将发布的美国股票收益公告。当用户请求收益日历数据、想要了解哪些公司将在下周报告收益或需要每周收益审核时，请使用此选项。该技能侧重于具有重大市场影响的中型及以上公司（市值超过 20 亿美元），以干净的降价表格式按日期和时间组织数据。通过灵活的 API 密钥管理支持多种环境（CLI、桌面、Web）。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.title: earnings-trade-analyzer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.description: Analyze recent post-earnings stocks using a 5-factor scoring system (Gap Size, Pre-Earnings Trend, Volume Trend, MA200 Position, MA50 Position). Scores each stock 0-100 and assigns A/B/C/D grades. Use when user asks about earnings trade analysis, post-earnings momentum screening, earnings gap scoring, or finding best recent earnings reactions.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.descriptionCn: 使用 5 因素评分系统（差距大小、盈利前趋势、交易量趋势、MA200 头寸、MA50 头寸）分析近期盈利后股票。对每只股票进行 0-100 分评分并分配 A/B/C/D 等级。当用户询问收益交易分析、收益后动量筛选、收益差距评分或查找近期最佳收益反应时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/edge-c.title: edge-candidate-agent

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionCn: 使用 TraderMonty 的公共 CSV 数据量化市场广度健康状况。生成 6 个组件的 0-100 综合分数（100 = 健康）。无需 API 密钥。当用户询问市场广度、参与率、上涨-下跌健康状况、反弹是否广泛或一般市场健康评估时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.title: market-environment-analysis
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.description: Comprehensive market environment analysis and reporting tool. Analyzes global markets including US, European, Asian markets, forex, commodities, and economic indicators. Provides risk-on/risk-off assessment, sector analysis, and technical indicator interpretation. Triggers on keywords like market analysis, market environment, global markets, trading environment, market conditions, investment climate, market sentiment, forex analysis, stock market analysis, 相場環境, 市場分析, マーケット状況, 投資環境.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionEn: Comprehensive market environment analysis and reporting tool. Analyzes global markets including US, European, Asian markets, forex, commodities, and economic indicators. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionCn: 全面的市场环境分析和报告工具。分析全球市场，包括美国、欧洲、亚洲市场、外汇、大宗商品和经济指标。提供风险规避/风险评估、行业分析和技术指标解读。触发市场分析、市场环境、全球市场、交易环境、市场状况、投资环境、市场情绪、外汇分析、股票市场分析、相场环境、市场分析、マーケット状况、投资环境等关键词。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.title: market-news-analyst
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.description: This skill should be used when analyzing recent market-moving news events and their impact on equity markets and commodities. Use this skill when the user requests analysis of major financial news from the past 10 days, wants to understand market reactions to monetary policy decisions (FOMC, ECB, BOJ), needs assessment of geopolitical events' impact on commodities, or requires comprehensive review of earnings announcements from mega-cap stocks. The skill automatically collects news using WebSearch/WebFetch tools and produces impact-ranked analysis reports. All analysis thinking and output are conducted in English.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionEn: This skill should be used when analyzing recent market-moving news events and their impact on equity markets and commodities. Use this skill when the user requests analysis of major financial news from the past 10 days, wants to understand market reactions to monetary policy decisions (FOMC, ECB, BOJ), needs assessment of geopolitical events' impact on commodities, or requires comprehensive review of earnings announcements from mega-cap stocks. The skill automatically collects news using WebSearch/WebFetch tools and produces impact-ranked analysis reports. All analysis thinking and output are conducted in English.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionCn: 在分析最近影响市场的新闻事件及其对股票市场和大宗商品的影响时，应该使用这项技能。当用户请求分析过去 10 天的主要财经新闻、想要了解市场对货币政策决策（FOMC、ECB、BOJ）的反应、需要评估地缘政治事件对大宗商品的影响或需要全面审查大型股的盈利公告时，请使用此技能。该技能使用 WebSearch/WebFetch 工具自动收集新闻并生成影响排名的分析报告。所有的分析思维和输出都是用英语进行的。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.title: market-top-detector
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.description: Detects market top probability using O'Neil Distribution Days, Minervini Leading Stock Deterioration, and Monty Defensive Sector Rotation. Generates a 0-100 composite score with risk zone classification. Use when user asks about market top risk, distribution days, defensive rotation, leadership breakdown, or whether to reduce equity exposure. Focuses on 2-8 week tactical timing signals for 10-20% corrections.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionEn: Detects market top probability using O'Neil Distribution Days, Minervini Leading Stock Deterioration, and Monty Defensive Sector Rotation. Generates a 0-100 composite score with risk zone classification. Use when user asks about market top risk, distribution days, defensive rotation, leadership breakdown, or whether to reduce equity exposure. Focuses on 2-8 week tactical timing signals for 10-20% corrections.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.descriptionCn: 使用奥尼尔分布日、米勒维尼领先股票恶化和蒙蒂防御性板块轮换来检测市场最高概率。生成 0-100 的综合评分以及风险区域分类。当用户询问市场最高风险、分配天数、防守轮换、领导力崩溃或是否减少股票敞口时使用。重点关注 2-8 周的战术时机信号，进行 10-20% 的修正。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/option.title: options-strategy-advisor
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/option.description: Options trading strategy analysis and simulation tool. Provides theoretical pricing using Black-Scholes model, Greeks calculation, strategy P/L simulation, and risk management guidance. Use when user requests options strategy analysis, covered calls, protective puts, spreads, iron condors, earnings plays, or options risk management. Includes volatility analysis, position sizing, and earnings-based strategy recommendations. Educational focus with practical trade simulation.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/option.descriptionEn: Options trading strategy analysis and simulation tool. Provides theoretical pricing using Black-Scholes model, Greeks calculation, strategy P/L simulation, and risk management guidance. Use when user requests options strategy analysis, covered calls, protective puts, spreads, iron condors, earnings plays, or options risk management. Includes volatility analysis, position sizing, and earnings-based strategy recommendations. Educational focus with practical trade simulation.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/option.descriptionCn: 期权交易策略分析和模拟工具。使用 Black-Scholes 模型、Greeks 计算、策略损益模拟和风险管理指导提供理论定价。当用户请求期权策略分析、备兑看涨期权、保护性看跌期权、价差、铁秃鹰、收益分析或期权风险管理时使用。包括波动性分析、头寸规模和基于收益的策略建议。以实际贸易模拟为重点的教育。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pair-t.title: pair-trade-screener
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pair-t.description: Statistical arbitrage tool for identifying and analyzing pair trading opportunities. Detects cointegrated stock pairs within sectors, analyzes spread behavior, calculates z-scores, and provides entry/exit recommendations for market-neutral strategies. Use when user requests pair trading opportunities, statistical arbitrage screening, mean-reversion strategies, or market-neutral portfolio construction. Supports correlation analysis, cointegration testing, and spread backtesting.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pair-t.descriptionEn: Statistical arbitrage tool for identifying and analyzing pair trading opportunities. Detects cointegrated stock pairs within sectors, analyzes spread behavior, calculates z-scores, and provides entry/exit recommendations for market-neutral strategies. Use when user requests pair trading opportunities, statistical arbitrage screening, mean-reversion strategies, or market-neutral portfolio construction. Supports correlation analysis, cointegration testing, and spread backtesting.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pair-t.descriptionCn: 用于识别和分析配对交易机会的统计套利工具。检测行业内的协整股票对，分析价差行为，计算 z 分数，并为市场中性策略提供进入/退出建议。当用户请求配对交易机会、统计套利筛选、均值回归策略或市场中性投资组合构建时使用。支持相关分析、协整测试、价差回测。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pead-s.title: pead-screener
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pead-s.description: Screen post-earnings gap-up stocks for PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) patterns. Analyzes weekly candle formation to detect red candle pullbacks and breakout signals. Supports two input modes - FMP earnings calendar (Mode A) or earnings-trade-analyzer JSON output (Mode B). Use when user asks about PEAD screening, post-earnings drift, earnings gap follow-through, red candle breakout patterns, or weekly earnings momentum setups.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pead-s.descriptionEn: Screen post-earnings gap-up stocks for PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) patterns. Use when user asks about PEAD screening, post-earnings drift, earnings gap follow-through, red candle breakout patterns, or weekly earnings momentum setups.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pead-s.descriptionCn: 筛选盈利后缺口股票的 PEAD（盈利公告后漂移）模式。分析每周蜡烛的形成，以检测红蜡烛回调和突破信号。支持两种输入模式 - FMP 收益日历（模式 A）或收益交易分析器 JSON 输出（模式 B）。当用户询问 PEAD 筛选、盈利后漂移、盈利差距跟踪、红烛突破模式或每周盈利动量设置时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/portfo.title: portfolio-manager
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/portfo.description: Comprehensive portfolio analysis using Alpaca MCP Server integration to fetch holdings and positions, then analyze asset allocation, risk metrics, individual stock positions, diversification, and generate rebalancing recommendations. Use when user requests portfolio review, position analysis, risk assessment, performance evaluation, or rebalancing suggestions for their brokerage account.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/portfo.descriptionEn: Comprehensive portfolio analysis using Alpaca MCP Server integration to fetch holdings and positions, then analyze asset allocation, risk metrics, individual stock positions, diversification, and generate rebalancing recommendations. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/portfo.descriptionCn: 使用 Alpaca MCP 服务器集成进行全面的投资组合分析，获取持仓和仓位，然后分析资产配置、风险指标、个股仓位、多元化，并生成再平衡建议。当用户请求为其经纪账户进行投资组合审查、头寸分析、风险评估、绩效评估或重新平衡建议时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/positi.title: position-sizer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/positi.description: Calculate risk-based position sizes for long stock trades. Use when user asks about position sizing, how many shares to buy, risk per trade, Kelly criterion, ATR-based sizing, or portfolio risk allocation. Supports stop-loss distance calculation, volatility scaling, and sector concentration checks.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/positi.descriptionEn: Calculate risk-based position sizes for long stock trades. Use when user asks about position sizing, how many shares to buy, risk per trade, Kelly criterion, ATR-based sizing, or portfolio risk allocation. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/positi.descriptionCn: 计算多头股票交易的基于风险的头寸规模。当用户询问头寸规模、购买多少股票、每笔交易的风险、凯利标准、基于 ATR 的规模或投资组合风险分配时使用。支持止损距离计算、波动率缩放和行业集中度检查。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/scenar.title: scenario-analyzer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/scenar.description:
ニュースヘッドラインを入力として18ヶ月シナリオを分析するスキル。
scenario-analystエージェントで主分析を実行し、
strategy-reviewerエージェントでセカンドオピニオンを取得。
1次・2次・3次影響、推奨銘柄、レビューを含む包括的レポートを日本語で生成。
使用例: /scenario-analyzer "Fed raises rates by 50bp"
トリガー: ニュース分析、シナリオ分析、18ヶ月展望、中長期投資戦略

使用示例：/scenario-analyzer“美联储加息 50 个基点”  
触发点：新闻分析、情景分析、18个月展望、中长期投资策略

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/sector.title: sector-analyst
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/sector.description: This skill should be used when analyzing sector and industry performance charts to assess market positioning and rotation patterns. Use this skill when the user provides performance chart images (1-week or 1-month timeframes) for sectors or industries and requests market cycle assessment, sector rotation analysis, or strategic positioning recommendations based on performance data. All analysis and output are conducted in English.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/sector.descriptionEn: This skill should be used when analyzing sector and industry performance charts to assess market positioning and rotation patterns. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/signal.title: signal-postmortem

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/stanle.title: stanley-druckenmiller-investment
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/stanle.description: スタンレー・ドラッケンミラーの投資哲学と戦略に基づいた投資アドバイスを提供。30年間無敗、年率30%近いリターンを達成した伝説的投資家の思考法を活用し、マクロ経済分析、リスク管理、ポジション構築、市場サイクルの読み方などについて実践的な指導を行う。投資判断、市場分析、リスク管理、ポートフォリオ構築などの相談時に使用。
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/stanle.descriptionEn: スタンレー・ドラッケンミラーの投資哲学と戦略に基づいた投資アドバイスを提供。30年間無敗、年率30%近いリターンを達成した伝説的投資家の思考法を活用し、マクロ経済分析、リスク管理、ポジション構築、市場サイクルの読み方などについて実践的な指導を行う。投資判断、市場分析、リスク管理、ポートフォリオ構築などの相談時に使用。
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/stanle.descriptionCn: 根据斯坦利·德鲁肯米勒的投资理念和策略提供投资建议。借鉴30年不败、年回报率近30%的传奇投资者的思维方式，为宏观经济分析、风险管理、仓位调整和解读市场周期提供实用指导。在寻求有关投资决策、市场分析、风险控制和投资组合构建的建议时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/strate.title: strategy-pivot-designer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/strate.description: Detect backtest iteration stagnation and generate structurally different strategy pivot proposals when parameter tuning reaches a local optimum.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/strate.descriptionEn: Detect backtest iteration stagnation and generate structurally different strategy pivot proposals when parameter tuning reaches a local optimum.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/strate.descriptionCn: 当参数调整达到局部最优时，检测回测迭代停滞并生成结构不同的策略枢轴提案。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/techni.title: technical-analyst

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/trader.title: trader-memory-core

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/trader.descriptionCn: 跟踪投资论文的整个生命周期——从筛选创意到通过事后分析结清头寸。从筛选器输出中注册论文、管理状态转换、附加头寸规模、审查截止日期并通过损益和 MAE/MFE 分析生成事后分析报告。当用户说“注册论文”、“跟踪这个想法”、“论文状态”、“到期审查”、“平仓”、“事后分析”或“交易日志”时触发。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.title: uptrend-analyzer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.description: Analyzes market breadth using Monty's Uptrend Ratio Dashboard data to diagnose the current market environment. Generates a 0-100 composite score from 5 components (breadth, sector participation, rotation, momentum, historical context). Use when asking about market breadth, uptrend ratios, or whether the market environment supports equity exposure. No API key required.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/us-mar.description: Evaluates market bubble risk through quantitative data-driven analysis using the revised Minsky/Kindleberger framework v2.1. Prioritizes objective metrics (Put/Call, VIX, margin debt, breadth, IPO data) over subjective impressions. Features strict qualitative adjustment criteria with confirmation bias prevention. Supports practical investment decisions with mandatory data collection and mechanical scoring. Use when user asks about bubble risk, valuation concerns, or profit-taking timing.

trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.title: using-jj
trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.description: Use this skill for ANY task involving jj or jujutsu version control. ALWAYS trigger when the user mentions jj, jujutsu, revsets, change IDs, bookmarks, or oplog. Also trigger when the user wants to squash, split, or reorder commits in a stack, write a revset query, absorb fixup changes, undo or restore a previous operation, resolve conflicts after rebasing, recover from force-pushes, rewrite protected/immutable commits, view change evolution (evolog), or try parallel approaches. Trigger even if "jj" is not explicitly said — "changes" instead of "commits", "stack" instead of "branch", "absorb", "squash into the right commit", "undo my last operation", "conflict after rebase", or "compare approaches in parallel" are strong jj signals. This skill contains critical non-obvious rules (like always using -m flags) that prevent broken workflows.

trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.descriptionCn: 将此技能用于任何涉及 jj 或 jujutsu 版本控制的任务。当用户提及 jj、jujutsu、revsets、更改 ID、书签或 oplog 时始终触发。当用户想要压缩、分割或重新排序堆栈中的提交、编写修订集查询、吸收修复更改、撤消或恢复先前的操作、解决变基后的冲突、从强制推送中恢复、重写受保护/不可变的提交、查看更改演变 (evolog) 或尝试并行方法时，也会触发。即使没有明确说出“jj”，也会触发 - “更改”而不是“提交”、“堆栈”而不是“分支”、“吸收”、“压缩到正确的提交”、“撤消我的上一个操作”、“变基后冲突”或“并行比较方法”都是强 jj 信号。该技能包含关键的非显而易见的规则（例如始终使用 -m 标志），可以防止工作流程中断。

tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.title: proofreader
tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.description:
文章の校正・推敲を行うスキル。誤字脱字・文法ミス・表現の改善点を指摘し、修正案を提示する。

スラッシュコマンドで呼び出されたとき（例: `/proofreader report.md` や `/proofreader ./docs/readme.txt`）は、引数に渡されたファイルを読み込んで校正を行う。

「校正して」「推敲して」「文章を見直して」「誤字脱字チェックして」「ちゃんと校正してよ」など、文章の品質確認や修正を求められたときは、直前にセッション内で生成・提示した文面を校正する。対象が複数ある場合や不明な場合は確認する。

日本語・英語どちらの文章にも対応する。メールの草稿・ドキュメント・ブログ記事・コードのコメントなど、文章であれば種類を問わず校正できる。

校正・推敲・誤字チェックの依頼があったときは必ずこのスキルを参照すること。

tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.descriptionCn:
校对和修改文本的技能。它会发现拼写错误、语法错误以及需要更好措辞的地方，然后提供更正。

当通过斜杠命令（例如“/proofreader report.md”或“/proofreader ./docs/readme.txt”）调用时，它会读取指定的文件并对其进行校对。

当被要求“校对”、“修改”、“检查拼写错误”、“正确校对”等时，它会更正会话中最近生成或显示的文本。如果存在多个或不明确的目标，则要求确认。

可以处理日语和英语。可以校对任何书面内容：电子邮件草稿、文档、博客文章、代码注释——无限制。

每当需要校对、修改或打字检查时，请务必查阅此技能。

- 「調べて」「リサーチして」「調査して」「〇〇について知りたい」と言われたとき
- 市場動向・技術トレンド・競合分析・業界動向・社会課題などの調査が必要なとき
- 「壁打ちしたい」「一緒に考えたい」「課題を整理したい」「情報を整理してほしい」という場合
- 意思決定のために複数の視点や選択肢を比較・整理したいとき

udit19199/system-design-interview/system.description: Simulates a real system design technical interview. Use this skill whenever the user wants to practice system design interviews, be asked system design questions, get evaluated on their architecture answers, or receive structured feedback like a real interviewer would give. vercel/streamdown/streamdown.title: streamdown
vercel/streamdown/streamdown.description: Implement, configure, and customize Streamdown — a streaming-optimized React Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, and CJK support. Use when working with Streamdown setup, configuration, plugins, styling, security, or integration with AI streaming (e.g., Vercel AI SDK). Triggers on: (1) Installing or setting up Streamdown, (2) Configuring plugins (code, mermaid, math, cjk), (3) Styling or theming Streamdown output, (4) Integrating with AI chat/streaming, (5) Configuring security, link safety, or custom HTML tags, (6) Using carets, static mode, or custom components, (7) Troubleshooting Tailwind, Shiki, or Vite issues.
vercel/streamdown/streamdown.descriptionEn: Implement, configure, and customize Streamdown — a streaming-optimized React Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, and CJK support. Use when working with Streamdown setup, configuration, plugins, styling, security, or integration with AI streaming (e.g., Vercel AI SDK). Triggers on: (1) Installing or setting up Streamdown, (2) Configuring plugins (code, mermaid, math, cjk), (3) Styling or theming Streamdown output, (4) Integrating with AI chat/streaming, (5) Configuring security, link safety, or custom HTML tags, (6) Using carets, static mode, or custom components, (7) Troubleshooting Tailwind, Shiki, or Vite issues.
vercel/streamdown/streamdown.descriptionCn: 实现、配置和自定义 Streamdown — 一个流优化的 React Markdown 渲染器，具有语法突出显示、美人鱼图、数学渲染和 CJK 支持。在使用 Streamdown 设置、配置、插件、样式、安全性或与 AI 流集成（例如 Vercel AI SDK）时使用。触发条件：(1) 安装或设置 Streamdown，(2) 配置插件（code、mermaid、math、cjk），(3) 设置 Streamdown 输出的样式或主题，(4) 与 AI 聊天/流媒体集成，(5) 配置安全性、链接安全或自定义 HTML 标签，(6) 使用插入符号、静态模式或自定义组件，(7) 解决 Tailwind、Shiki 或 Vite 问题。

Use for any headless commerce project that must never expose VTEX_APP_KEY or call private VTEX APIs from the browser.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-bff-architec.descriptionEn: Apply when designing or modifying a BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layer, middleware, or API proxy for a headless VTEX storefront. Covers BFF middleware architecture, public vs private API classification, VtexIdclientAutCookie management, API key protection, and secure request proxying. Use for any headless commerce project that must never expose VTEX_APP_KEY or call private VTEX APIs from the browser.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-bff-architec.descriptionCn: 在设计或修改无头 VTEX 店面的 BFF（前端后端）层、中间件或 API 代理时应用。涵盖 BFF 中间件架构、公共与私有 API 分类、VtexIdclientAutCookie 管理、API 密钥保护和安全请求代理。用于任何绝不能公开 VTEX_APP_KEY 或从浏览器调用私有 VTEX API 的无头商业项目。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-caching-stra.title: headless-caching-strategy
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-caching-stra.description: Apply when implementing caching logic, CDN configuration, or performance optimization for a headless VTEX storefront. Covers which VTEX APIs can be cached (Intelligent Search, Catalog) versus which must never be cached (Checkout, Profile, OMS), stale-while-revalidate patterns, cache invalidation, and BFF-level caching. Use for any headless project that needs TTL rules and caching strategy guidance.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-caching-stra.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing caching logic, CDN configuration, or performance optimization for a headless VTEX storefront. Covers which VTEX APIs can be cached (Intelligent Search, Catalog) versus which must never be cached (Checkout, Profile, OMS), stale-while-revalidate patterns, cache invalidation, and BFF-level caching. Use for any headless project that needs TTL rules and caching strategy guidance.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-caching-stra.descriptionCn: 在为无头 VTEX 店面实现缓存逻辑、CDN 配置或性能优化时应用。涵盖哪些 VTEX API 可以缓存（智能搜索、目录），哪些 VTEX API 绝对不能缓存（检出、配置文件、OMS）、重新验证时过时模式、缓存失效和 BFF 级缓存。用于任何需要 TTL 规则和缓存策略指导的无头项目。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-checkout-pro.title: headless-checkout-proxy
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-checkout-pro.description: Apply when implementing cart, checkout, or order placement logic proxied through a BFF for headless VTEX storefronts. Covers OrderForm lifecycle, cart creation, item management, profile/shipping/payment attachments, orderFormId management, and secure checkout flows. Use for any headless frontend that needs to proxy VTEX Checkout API calls through a server-side layer with proper session cookie handling.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-checkout-pro.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing cart, checkout, or order placement logic proxied through a BFF for headless VTEX storefronts. Covers OrderForm lifecycle, cart creation, item management, profile/shipping/payment attachments, orderFormId management, and secure checkout flows. Use for any headless frontend that needs to proxy VTEX Checkout API calls through a server-side layer with proper session cookie handling.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-checkout-pro.descriptionCn: 在为无头 VTEX 店面实现通过 BFF 代理的购物车、结账或下单逻辑时应用。涵盖 OrderForm 生命周期、购物车创建、项目管理、配置文件/运输/付款附件、orderFormId 管理和安全结帐流程。用于任何需要通过具有适当会话 cookie 处理的服务器端层代理 VTEX Checkout API 调用的无头前端。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.title: headless-intelligent-search
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.description: Apply when implementing search functionality, faceted navigation, or autocomplete in a headless VTEX storefront. Covers product_search, autocomplete_suggestions, facets, banners, correction_search, and top_searches endpoints, plus analytics event collection. Use for any custom frontend that integrates VTEX Intelligent Search API for product discovery and search result rendering.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing search functionality, faceted navigation, or autocomplete in a headless VTEX storefront. Covers product_search, autocomplete_suggestions, facets, banners, correction_search, and top_searches endpoints, plus analytics event collection. Use for any custom frontend that integrates VTEX Intelligent Search API for product discovery and search result rendering.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.descriptionCn: 在无头 VTEX 店面中实现搜索功能、分面导航或自动完成时应用。涵盖product_search、autocomplete_suggestions、facet、banner、 Correction_search 和 top_searches 端点，以及分析事件集合。用于集成 VTEX 智能搜索 API 的任何自定义前端，以进行产品发现和搜索结果呈现。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.title: marketplace-catalog-sync
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.description: Apply when building catalog or SKU synchronization logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the changenotification endpoint, SKU suggestion lifecycle, product data mapping, price and inventory sync, and fulfillment simulation. Use for implementing seller-side catalog integration that pushes SKUs to VTEX marketplaces with proper notification handling and rate-limited batch synchronization.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.descriptionEn: Apply when building catalog or SKU synchronization logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the changenotification endpoint, SKU suggestion lifecycle, product data mapping, price and inventory sync, and fulfillment simulation. Use for implementing seller-side catalog integration that pushes SKUs to VTEX marketplaces with proper notification handling and rate-limited batch synchronization.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场卖家连接器构建目录或 SKU 同步逻辑时应用。涵盖变更通知端点、SKU 建议生命周期、产品数据映射、价格和库存同步以及履行模拟。用于实施卖方目录集成，通过适当的通知处理和限速批量同步将 SKU 推送到 VTEX 市场。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.title: marketplace-fulfillment
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.description: Apply when implementing fulfillment, invoice, or tracking logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the Order Invoice Notification API, invoice payload structure, tracking updates, partial invoicing for split shipments, and the authorize fulfillment flow. Use for building seller-side order fulfillment that integrates with VTEX marketplace order management including the 2.5s simulation timeout.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing fulfillment, invoice, or tracking logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the Order Invoice Notification API, invoice payload structure, tracking updates, partial invoicing for split shipments, and the authorize fulfillment flow. Use for building seller-side order fulfillment that integrates with VTEX marketplace order management including the 2.5s simulation timeout.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场卖家连接器实施履行、发票或跟踪逻辑时应用。涵盖订单发票通知 API、发票有效负载结构、跟踪更新、拆分装运的部分发票以及授权履行流程。用于构建与 VTEX 市场订单管理集成的卖方订单履行（包括 2.5 秒模拟超时）。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.title: marketplace-order-hook
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.description: Apply when implementing order integration hooks, feeds, or webhook handlers for VTEX marketplace connectors. Covers Feed v3 (pull) vs Hook (push), filter types (FromWorkflow and FromOrders), order status lifecycle, payload validation, and idempotent processing. Use for building order integrations between VTEX marketplaces and external systems such as ERPs, WMS, or fulfillment services.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing order integration hooks, feeds, or webhook handlers for VTEX marketplace connectors. Covers Feed v3 (pull) vs Hook (push), filter types (FromWorkflow and FromOrders), order status lifecycle, payload validation, and idempotent processing. Use for building order integrations between VTEX marketplaces and external systems such as ERPs, WMS, or fulfillment services.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场连接器实现订单集成挂钩、提要或 Webhook 处理程序时应用。涵盖 Feed v3（拉）与 Hook（推）、过滤器类型（FromWorkflow 和 FromOrders）、订单状态生命周期、有效负载验证和幂等处理。用于在 VTEX 市场和外部系统（例如 ERP、WMS 或履行服务）之间构建订单集成。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.title: marketplace-rate-limiting
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.description: Apply when implementing retry logic, rate limit handling, or resilience patterns in VTEX API integrations. Covers VTEX rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After), 429 status handling, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaker patterns, and request queuing. Use for any VTEX marketplace integration that must gracefully handle API throttling and maintain high availability.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing retry logic, rate limit handling, or resilience patterns in VTEX API integrations. Covers VTEX rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After), 429 status handling, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaker patterns, and request queuing. Use for any VTEX marketplace integration that must gracefully handle API throttling and maintain high availability.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.descriptionCn: 在 VTEX API 集成中实现重试逻辑、速率限制处理或弹性模式时应用。涵盖 VTEX 速率限制标头（X-RateLimit-Remaining、X-RateLimit-Reset、Retry-After）、429 状态处理、抖动指数退避、断路器模式和请求排队。用于任何必须妥善处理 API 限制并保持高可用性的 VTEX 市场集成。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.title: payment-async-flow
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.description: Apply when implementing asynchronous payment methods (Boleto, Pix, bank redirects) or working with callback URLs in payment connector code. Covers undefined status response, callbackUrl notification, X-VTEX-signature validation, sync vs async handling, and the 7-day retry window. Use for any payment flow where authorization does not complete synchronously.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing asynchronous payment methods (Boleto, Pix, bank redirects) or working with callback URLs in payment connector code. Covers undefined status response, callbackUrl notification, X-VTEX-signature validation, sync vs async handling, and the 7-day retry window. Use for any payment flow where authorization does not complete synchronously.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.descriptionCn: 在实现异步支付方法（Boleto、Pix、银行重定向）或在支付连接器代码中使用回调 URL 时应用。涵盖未定义的状态响应、callbackUrl 通知、X-VTEX 签名验证、同步与异步处理以及 7 天重试窗口。用于授权未同步完成的任何支付流程。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.title: payment-idempotency
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.description: Apply when implementing idempotency logic in payment connector code or handling duplicate payment requests. Covers paymentId as idempotency key, payment state machine transitions, retry semantics for cancellation and refund operations, and requestId handling. Use for preventing duplicate charges and ensuring correct Gateway retry behavior across Create Payment, Cancel, Capture, and Refund endpoints.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing idempotency logic in payment connector code or handling duplicate payment requests. Covers paymentId as idempotency key, payment state machine transitions, retry semantics for cancellation and refund operations, and requestId handling. Use for preventing duplicate charges and ensuring correct Gateway retry behavior across Create Payment, Cancel, Capture, and Refund endpoints.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.descriptionCn: 在支付连接器代码中实现幂等性逻辑或处理重复的支付请求时应用。涵盖作为幂等键的 paymentId、支付状态机转换、取消和退款操作的重试语义以及 requestId 处理。用于防止重复收费并确保跨“创建付款”、“取消”、“捕获”和“退款”端点的网关重试行为正确。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.title: payment-pci-security
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.description: Apply when handling credit card data, implementing secureProxyUrl flows, or working with payment security and proxy code. Covers PCI DSS compliance, Secure Proxy card tokenization, sensitive data handling rules, X-PROVIDER-Forward-To header usage, and custom token creation. Use for any payment connector that processes credit, debit, or co-branded card payments to prevent data breaches and PCI violations.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.descriptionEn: Apply when handling credit card data, implementing secureProxyUrl flows, or working with payment security and proxy code. Covers PCI DSS compliance, Secure Proxy card tokenization, sensitive data handling rules, X-PROVIDER-Forward-To header usage, and custom token creation. Use for any payment connector that processes credit, debit, or co-branded card payments to prevent data breaches and PCI violations.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.descriptionCn: 在处理信用卡数据、实施 secureProxyUrl 流或使用支付安全和代理代码时应用。涵盖 PCI DSS 合规性、安全代理卡令牌化、敏感数据处理规则、X-PROVIDER-Forward-To 标头使用以及自定义令牌创建。用于处理信用卡、借记卡或联名卡支付的任何支付连接器，以防止数据泄露和 PCI 违规。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.title: payment-provider-protocol
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.description: Apply when implementing a VTEX Payment Provider Protocol (PPP) connector or working with payment/connector endpoint files. Covers all nine required endpoints: Manifest, Create Payment, Cancel, Capture/Settle, Refund, Inbound Request, Create Auth Token, Provider Auth Redirect, and Get Credentials. Use for building or debugging any payment connector that integrates with the VTEX Payment Gateway.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing a VTEX Payment Provider Protocol (PPP) connector or working with payment/connector endpoint files. Covers all nine required endpoints: Manifest, Create Payment, Cancel, Capture/Settle, Refund, Inbound Request, Create Auth Token, Provider Auth Redirect, and Get Credentials. Use for building or debugging any payment connector that integrates with the VTEX Payment Gateway.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.descriptionCn: 在实现 VTEX 支付提供商协议 (PPP) 连接器或使用支付/连接器端点文件时应用。涵盖所有九个必需端点：清单、创建付款、取消、捕获/结算、退款、入站请求、创建身份验证令牌、提供商身份验证重定向和获取凭证。用于构建或调试与 VTEX 支付网关集成的任何支付连接器。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.title: vtex-io-app-structure
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.description: Apply when creating or modifying manifest.json, service.json, or node/package.json in a VTEX IO app. Covers builders (node, react, graphql, admin, pixel, messages, store), policy declarations, dependencies, peerDependencies, and app lifecycle management. Use for scaffolding new VTEX IO apps, configuring builders, or fixing deployment failures related to app structure and naming conventions.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.descriptionEn: Apply when creating or modifying manifest.json, service.json, or node/package.json in a VTEX IO app. Covers builders (node, react, graphql, admin, pixel, messages, store), policy declarations, dependencies, peerDependencies, and app lifecycle management. Use for scaffolding new VTEX IO apps, configuring builders, or fixing deployment failures related to app structure and naming conventions.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.descriptionCn: 在VTEX IO应用程序中创建或修改manifest.json、service.json或node/package.json时应用。涵盖构建器（node、react、graphql、admin、pixel、messages、store）、策略声明、依赖项、peerDependency 和应用程序生命周期管理。用于搭建新的 VTEX IO 应用程序、配置构建器或修复与应用程序结构和命名约定相关的部署失败。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.title: vtex-io-graphql-api
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.description: Apply when working with GraphQL schema files in graphql/ or implementing resolvers in node/resolvers/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers schema.graphql definitions, @cacheControl and @auth directives, custom type definitions, and resolver registration in the Service class. Use for exposing data through GraphQL queries and mutations with proper cache control and authentication enforcement.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.descriptionEn: Apply when working with GraphQL schema files in graphql/ or implementing resolvers in node/resolvers/ for VTEX IO apps. vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.title: vtex-io-masterdata
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.description: Apply when working with MasterData v2 entities, schemas, or MasterDataClient in VTEX IO apps. Covers data entities, JSON Schema definitions, CRUD operations, the masterdata builder, triggers, search and scroll operations, and schema lifecycle management. Use for storing, querying, and managing custom data in VTEX IO apps while avoiding the 60-schema limit through proper schema versioning.

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.title: vtex-io-react-apps
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.description: Apply when building React components under react/ or configuring store blocks in store/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers interfaces.json, contentSchemas.json for Site Editor, VTEX Styleguide for admin apps, and css-handles for storefront styling. vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.title: vtex-io-service-apps
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.description: Apply when building backend service apps under node/ in a VTEX IO project or configuring service.json routes. Covers the Service class, middleware functions, ctx.clients pattern, JanusClient, ExternalClient, MasterDataClient, and IOClients registration. Use for implementing backend APIs, event handlers, or integrations that must use @vtex/api clients instead of raw HTTP libraries.

wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.description: Use when asked to "jobs to be done", "JTBD", "why customers churn", "prep for customer interviews", "hire and fire products", or "find real competitors".
