wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "jobs to be done", "JTBD", "why customers churn", "prep for customer interviews", "hire and fire products", or "find real competitors". Helps discover unmet needs and the context behind purchasing decisions. The Jobs to be Done framework (created by Clayton Christensen and Bob Moesta) explains why customers hire and fire products.
wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.descriptionCn: 当被问到“要做的工作”、“JTBD”、“客户流失的原因”、“准备客户访谈”、“雇用和解雇产品”或“寻找真正的竞争对手”时使用。帮助发现未满足的需求以及购买决策背后的背景。 “待完成的工作”框架（由 Clayton Christensen 和 Bob Moesta 创建）解释了客户雇用和解雇产品的原因。

wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.title: monetizing-innovation
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.description: Use when asked about "pricing strategy", "willingness to pay", "value metric", "packaging tiers", "good better best pricing", "subscription vs usage pricing", or "price before product". Helps design products customers will pay for and choose pricing models that capture value. Based on Madhavan Ramanujam's Monetizing Innovation framework from Simon-Kucher.
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "pricing strategy", "willingness to pay", "value metric", "packaging tiers", "good better best pricing", "subscription vs usage pricing", or "price before product". Helps design products customers will pay for and choose pricing models that capture value. Based on Madhavan Ramanujam's Monetizing Innovation framework from Simon-Kucher.
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.descriptionCn: 当被问及“定价策略”、“支付意愿”、“价值指标”、“包装等级”、“好更好的最佳定价”、“订阅与使用定价”或“产品之前的价格”时使用。帮助设计客户愿意付费的产品并选择能够获取价值的定价模型。基于 Simon-Kucher Madhavan Ramanujam 的货币化创新框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.title: okrs
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.description: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionCn: 当被要求“设定 OKR”、“目标和关键结果”、“季度 OKR 规划”、“调整目标”、“衡量 OKR 进度”或“通过 OKR 关注优先事项”时使用。帮助团队专注于最重要的事情并创造进步的节奏。 OKR 框架（由英特尔的安迪·格罗夫 (Andy Grove) 发起，由谷歌的约翰·杜尔 (John Doerr) 推广）创建了一致性、焦点和学习周期。 Christina Wodtke 的激进聚焦方法强调简单性并避免常见的陷阱。

wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.title: opportunity-solution-trees
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.description: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". Helps product teams connect outcomes to customer opportunities and test solutions with Opportunity Solution Trees (created by Teresa Torres).
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". Helps product teams connect outcomes to customer opportunities and test solutions with Opportunity Solution Trees (created by Teresa Torres).
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“机会解决方案树”、“OST”、“Teresa Torres”、“将客户机会映射到结果”、“围绕机会构建发现”或“比较客户需求的解决方案”时使用。帮助产品团队将结果与客户机会联系起来，并使用机会解决方案树（由 Teresa Torres 创建）测试解决方案。

wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.title: pmf-survey
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.description: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionCn: 当被要求“PMF 调查”、“衡量产品市场契合度”、“40% 规则”、“Sean Ellis 测试”、“Rahul Vohra 方法”或“您会感到多么失望”时使用。帮助量化产品与市场的契合度并系统地改进它。 PMF 调查框架（由 Sean Ellis 创建，由 Super human 的 Rahul Vohra 推广）衡量如果没有您的产品，用户会有多失望，并将这些数据转化为路线图。

wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.title: positioning-canvas
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.description: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“定位我的产品”、“定位画布”、“与竞争对手区分开来”、“弄清楚我们的类别”、“重新定位”或“为什么客户应该选择我们”时使用。帮助定义有竞争力的替代方案、差异化价值、目标客户和市场类别。 April Dunford 的“Obviously Awesome”定位框架使您的产品价值对合适的客户来说是显而易见的。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-growth
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被问及“产品主导的增长”、“PLG 策略”、“自助增长”、“免费增值模式”、“免费试用设计”、“产品主导的销售”、“PQL”或“自下而上的增长”时使用。帮助设计和优化以产品为主导的增长动作，其中产品推动获取、激活和货币化。基于 Elena Verna 和 Hila Qu 的框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-seo
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“以产品为主导的 SEO”、“程序化 SEO”、“构建程序化页面”、“产品的有机获取”、“决定 SEO 是否值得”或“优化 AI 搜索”时使用。帮助评估 SEO 是否适合您的商业模式以及如何将其作为产品而不仅仅是营销。以产品为主导的 SEO 框架（由 Eli Schwartz 创建）将 SEO 视为为搜索用户构建产品。

wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.title: radical-candor
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.description: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionCn: 当被要求“彻底坦率”、“提供关心的反馈”、“进行一次艰难的对话”、“直接挑战”、“管理绩效问题”或“给予有效的赞扬”时使用。帮助提供直接反馈，同时向您表示关心。 Radical Candor 框架（由 Kim Scott 创建）教导如何在关心个人的同时直接挑战。

wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.title: seven-powers
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.description: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionCn: 当被要求“七大力量”、“建立竞争护城河”、“分析防御性”、“寻找可持续优势”、“经济护城河”或“汉密尔顿·赫尔默框架”时使用。帮助确定持久的竞争优势。七权框架（由 Hamilton Helmer 创建）揭示了保护商业价值免受竞争的经济结构。

wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.title: shape-up
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.description: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". Helps teams escape estimate-driven development and Scrum fatigue. The Shape Up method (created by Ryan Singer at Basecamp/37signals) uses fixed time boxes, variable scope, and collaborative shaping to ship meaningful work predictably.
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". Helps teams escape estimate-driven development and Scrum fatigue. The Shape Up method (created by Ryan Singer at Basecamp/37signals) uses fixed time boxes, variable scope, and collaborative shaping to ship meaningful work predictably.
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.descriptionCn: 当被要求“塑造”、“进行塑造会议”、“设定胃口”、“在没有估计的情况下确定项目范围”、“投注表”或“按固定周期发货”时使用。帮助团队摆脱估计驱动的开发和 Scrum 疲劳。 Shape Up 方法（由 Basecamp/37signals 的 Ryan Singer 创建）使用固定时间框、可变范围和协作塑造来可预测地交付有意义的工作。

wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.title: strategic-narrative
wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.description: Use when asked to "strategic narrative", "Andy Raskin", "tell our company story", "write a pitch deck", "explain why customers should care", or "movement narrative". Helps craft compelling narratives that define movements rather than just selling products. The Strategic Narrative framework (created by Andy Raskin) transforms pitches from feature lists into stories about change.
wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "strategic narrative", "Andy Raskin", "tell our company story", "write a pitch deck", "explain why customers should care", or "movement narrative". Helps craft compelling narratives that define movements rather than just selling products. The Strategic Narrative framework (created by Andy Raskin) transforms pitches from feature lists into stories about change.
wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.descriptionCn: 当被要求“战略叙述”、“安迪·拉斯金”、“讲述我们公司的故事”、“撰写宣传材料”、“解释为什么客户应该关心”或“运动叙述”时使用。帮助制定引人入胜的叙述来定义运动，而不仅仅是销售产品。战略叙事框架（由安迪·拉斯金创建）将推介从功能列表转变为有关变革的故事。

wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.title: thinking-in-bets
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.description: Use when asked to "thinking in bets", "make decisions under uncertainty", "think probabilistically", "avoid resulting", "separate decision quality from outcomes", or "reduce bias in decisions". Helps make explicit bets and evaluate decisions on process, not results. The Thinking in Bets framework (from Annie Duke) applies poker strategy to business and life decisions.
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "thinking in bets", "make decisions under uncertainty", "think probabilistically", "avoid resulting", "separate decision quality from outcomes", or "reduce bias in decisions". Helps make explicit bets and evaluate decisions on process, not results. The Thinking in Bets framework (from Annie Duke) applies poker strategy to business and life decisions.
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“在赌注中思考”、“在不确定性下做出决定”、“概率性思考”、“避免结果”、“将决策质量与结果分开”或“减少决策中的偏差”时使用。帮助做出明确的赌注并根据过程而不是结果评估决策。投注思维框架（来自 Annie Duke）将扑克策略应用于商业和生活决策。

wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.title: trustworthy-experiments
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.description: Use when asked to "run an A/B test", "design an experiment", "check statistical significance", "trust our results", "avoid false positives", or "experiment guardrails". Helps design, run, and interpret controlled experiments correctly. Based on Ronny Kohavi's framework from "Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments".
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "run an A/B test", "design an experiment", "check statistical significance", "trust our results", "avoid false positives", or "experiment guardrails". Helps design, run, and interpret controlled experiments correctly. Based on Ronny Kohavi's framework from "Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments".
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“运行 A/B 测试”、“设计实验”、“检查统计显着性”、“相信我们的结果”、“避免误报”或“实验护栏”时使用。帮助正确设计、运行和解释受控实验。基于 Ronny Kohavi 的“值得信赖的在线控制实验”框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.title: working-backwards
wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.description: Use when asked to "working backwards", "PR/FAQ", "Amazon PR/FAQ", "write a press release", "define a new product", or "write a customer-focused PRD". Helps define products by starting with the customer problem and desired outcome before building. The Working Backwards process (developed at Amazon) forces clarity on customer value before committing engineering resources.
wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "working backwards", "PR/FAQ", "Amazon PR/FAQ", "write a press release", "define a new product", or "write a customer-focused PRD". Helps define products by starting with the customer problem and desired outcome before building. The Working Backwards process (developed at Amazon) forces clarity on customer value before committing engineering resources.
wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.descriptionCn: 当被要求“逆向工作”、“公关/常见问题解答”、“亚马逊公关/常见问题解答”、“撰写新闻稿”、“定义新产品”或“撰写以客户为中心的 PRD”时使用。在构建之前从客户问题和期望结果开始帮助定义产品。逆向工作流程（由亚马逊开发）强制在投入工程资源之前明确客户价值。

wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.title: youtube-render-pdf
wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.description: Generate a professional, detailed, figure-rich LaTeX course note and final PDF from a YouTube lecture, tutorial, or technical talk. Use when the user provides a YouTube URL and wants structured Chinese teaching notes that combine the video's title, chapters, diagrams, formulas, code, subtitle explanations, the original video cover on the front page, and a final synthesis chapter, with key frames extracted from the highest usable video resolution and inserted as figures, and where the final deliverable must include a rendered PDF.
wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.descriptionEn: Generate a professional, detailed, figure-rich LaTeX course note and final PDF from a YouTube lecture, tutorial, or technical talk. Use when the user provides a YouTube URL and wants structured Chinese teaching notes that combine the video's title, chapters, diagrams, formulas, code, subtitle explanations, the original video cover on the front page, and a final synthesis chapter, with key frames extracted from the highest usable video resolution and inserted as figures, and where the final deliverable must include a rendered PDF.
wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.descriptionCn: 从 YouTube 讲座、教程或技术讲座中生成专业、详细、图形丰富的 LaTeX 课程笔记和最终 PDF。当用户提供 YouTube URL 并想要结构化中文教学笔记时使用，其中结合了视频的标题、章节、图表、公式、代码、字幕解释、首页上的原始视频封面和最终综合章节，以及从最高可用视频分辨率中提取的关键帧并以图形形式插入，并且最终交付成果必须包括渲染的 PDF。

wdm0006/python-skills/building-python-cl.title: building-python-clis
wdm0006/python-skills/building-python-cl.description: Builds command-line interfaces for Python libraries using Click or Typer. Includes command groups, argument handling, progress bars, shell completion, and CLI testing with CliRunner. Use when adding CLI functionality to a library or building standalone command-line tools.
wdm0006/python-skills/building-python-cl.descriptionEn: Builds command-line interfaces for Python libraries using Click or Typer. Includes command groups, argument handling, progress bars, shell completion, and CLI testing with CliRunner. Use when adding CLI functionality to a library or building standalone command-line tools.
wdm0006/python-skills/building-python-cl.descriptionCn: 使用 Click 或 Typer 为 Python 库构建命令行界面。包括命令组、参数处理、进度条、shell 完成以及使用 CliRunner 进行 CLI 测试。在向库添加 CLI 功能或构建独立的命令行工具时使用。

wdm0006/python-skills/improving-python-c.title: improving-python-code-quality
wdm0006/python-skills/improving-python-c.description: Improves Python library code quality through ruff linting, mypy type checking, Pythonic idioms, and refactoring. Use when reviewing code for quality issues, adding type hints, configuring static analysis tools, or refactoring Python library code.
wdm0006/python-skills/improving-python-c.descriptionEn: Improves Python library code quality through ruff linting, mypy type checking, Pythonic idioms, and refactoring. Use when reviewing code for quality issues, adding type hints, configuring static analysis tools, or refactoring Python library code.
wdm0006/python-skills/improving-python-c.descriptionCn: 通过 ruff linting、mypy 类型检查、Pythonic 习语和重构提高 Python 库代码质量。在检查代码是否存在质量问题、添加类型提示、配置静态分析工具或重构 Python 库代码时使用。

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.title: native-to-weapp-vite-wevu-migration
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.description: Apply a structured migration workflow from native mini-program projects to weapp-vite and wevu. Use when converting Page/Component code to Vue SFC, replacing setData-heavy state updates with ref/reactive, migrating properties/observers/triggerEvent contracts, introducing platform guards, and building migration-focused e2e validation and rollback checkpoints.
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.descriptionEn: Apply a structured migration workflow from native mini-program projects to weapp-vite and wevu. Use when converting Page/Component code to Vue SFC, replacing setData-heavy state updates with ref/reactive, migrating properties/observers/triggerEvent contracts, introducing platform guards, and building migration-focused e2e validation and rollback checkpoints.
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.descriptionCn: 应用从原生小程序项目到 weapp-vite 和 wevu 的结构化迁移工作流程。将页面/组件代码转换为 Vue SFC、用 ref/reactive 替换 setData 重的状态更新、迁移属性/观察者/triggerEvent 合约、引入平台防护以及构建以迁移为中心的 e2e 验证和回滚检查点时使用。

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.title: playwright-cli
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.descriptionEn: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.descriptionCn: 自动执行浏览器交互以进行 Web 测试、表单填写、屏幕截图和数据提取。当用户需要导航网站、与网页交互、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、测试 Web 应用程序或从网页中提取信息时使用。

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/weapp-vite-best-pr.title: weapp-vite-best-practices

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: deliverable-selfloop
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Self-loop a deliverable until it is publishable by the pipeline standard: diagnose -> fix -> re-check, and write a PASS/FAIL report.
**Trigger**: self loop, self-loop, polish deliverable, quality gate, fix-on-fail, 收敛, 自循环, 质量门.
**Use when**: A pipeline has produced a reader-facing deliverable (`output/*.md`) and you want deterministic convergence to PASS.
**Skip if**: You are still pre-approval for prose or the upstream evidence/structure artifacts are missing.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not invent papers/citations/results. Only use in-scope inputs already present in the workspace.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: draft-polisher
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit-style editing pass for `output/DRAFT.md`: remove template boilerplate, improve coherence, and enforce citation anchoring.
**Trigger**: polish draft, de-template, coherence pass, remove boilerplate, 润色, 去套话, 去重复, 统一术语.
**Use when**: a first-pass draft exists but reads like scaffolding (repetition/ellipsis/template phrases) or needs a coherence pass before global review/LaTeX.
**Skip if**: the draft already reads human-grade and passes quality gates; or prose is not approved in `DECISIONS.md`.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add/remove/invent citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; do not change claims beyond what existing citations support.

**使用时**：存在第一遍草稿，但读起来像脚手架（重复/省略/模板短语）或在全局审查/LaTeX 之前需要连贯性。

**网络**：无。
**护栏**：不要添加/删除/发明引文键；不要跨小节移动引用；不要改变超出现有引文支持范围的主张。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evaluation-anchor-checker
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit and rewrite evaluation/numeric claims to ensure they carry minimal protocol context (task + metric + constraint) and avoid underspecified model naming.
**Trigger**: evaluation anchor checker, numeric claim hygiene, underspecified numbers, protocol context, 评测锚点检查, 数字断言, 指标上下文.
**Use when**: before final merge/polish, or when reviewers would likely flag claims as underspecified (numbers without task/metric/budget), or `pipeline-auditor` warns about suspicious model naming.
**Skip if**: evidence is too thin to justify numeric claims (route upstream to C3/C4), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent numbers; do not add/remove/move citation keys; if protocol context is missing, weaken/remove the numeric claim rather than guessing.

**触发器**：评估锚点检查器、数字声明卫生、未指定的数字、协议上下文、足球变量点检查、数字断言、指标上下文。
**使用时间**：在最终合并/完善之前，或者当审阅者可能将声明标记为未指定（没有任务/指标/预算的数字）时，或者“管道审核器”警告可疑模型命名时。
**如果**则跳过：证据太薄弱，无法证明数字主张的合理性（上游路线至 C3/C4），或者您处于 C2 之前（无散文）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：不要发明数字；不要添加/删除/移动引文键；如果协议上下文缺失，则削弱/删除数字声明而不是猜测。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-auditor

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 只写“缺口/风险/下一步验证”，不要替作者补写论述或引入新主张。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-binder
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Bind addressable evidence IDs from `papers/evidence_bank.jsonl` to each subsection (H3), producing `outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`.

**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent evidence; only select from the existing evidence bank.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-draft
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Create per-subsection evidence packs (NO PROSE): claim candidates, concrete comparisons, evaluation protocol, limitations, plus citation-backed evidence snippets with provenance.
**Trigger**: evidence draft, evidence pack, claim candidates, concrete comparisons, evidence snippets, provenance, 证据草稿, 证据包, 可引用事实.
**Use when**: `outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl` exists and you want evidence-first section drafting where every paragraph can be backed by traceable citations/snippets.
**Skip if**: `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl` already exists and is refined (no placeholders; >=8 comparisons per subsection; `blocking_missing` empty).
**Network**: none (richer evidence improves with abstracts/fulltext).
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent facts; only use citation keys that exist in `citations/ref.bib`.

**网络**：无（通过摘要/全文可以得到更丰富的证据）。
**护栏**：没有散文；不要捏造事实；仅使用存在于 `itations/ref.bib` 中的引文键。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-selfloop
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Evidence self-loop for surveys: read evidence bindings + evidence packs, then write an actionable upstream TODO plan (which stage/skill to fix) before writing more prose.
Writes `output/EVIDENCE_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`.
**Trigger**: evidence self-loop, evidence loop, evidence gaps, binding gaps, blocking_missing, 证据自循环, 证据缺口回路.
**Use when**: C4 outputs exist (`outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`, `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl`) but writing looks hollow or C5 is BLOCKED due to thin evidence.
**Skip if**: you are still pre-C3 (no notes/evidence bank yet), or you want to draft anyway and accept a lower evidence bar.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: analysis-only; do not edit evidence/writing artifacts; do not invent facts/citations; only write the TODO report.

写入“output/EVIDENCE_SELFLOOP_TODO.md”。
**触发器**：证据自循环、证据循环、证据间隙、绑定间隙、blocking_missing、证据自循环、证据缺口回路。

**网络**：无。
**护栏**：仅分析；不要编辑证据/书写工件；不要发明事实/引文；只写TODO报告。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: exercise-builder

**Trigger**: exercises, practice, verification checklist, 教程练习, 可验证作业.
**Use when**: 已有模块计划（`outline/module_plan.yml`），需要为每个模块补齐至少 1 个可验证练习以形成 teaching loop。
**Skip if**: 还没有 module plan（先跑 `module-planner`）。
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 每个练习必须包含 expected output + verification steps；避免只给“思考题”无验收。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: extraction-form

**Trigger**: extraction form, extraction table, data extraction, 信息提取, 提取表.

**Network**: none.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: global-reviewer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Global consistency review for survey drafts: terminology, cross-section coherence, and scope/citation hygiene.
Writes `output/GLOBAL_REVIEW.md` and (optionally) applies safe edits to `output/DRAFT.md`.
**Trigger**: global review, consistency check, coherence audit, 术语一致性, 全局回看, 章节呼应, 拷打 writer.
**Use when**: Draft exists and you want a final evidence-first coherence pass before LaTeX/PDF.
**Skip if**: You are still changing the outline/mapping/notes (do those first), or prose writing is not approved.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not invent facts or citations; do not add new citation keys; treat missing evidence as a failure signal.

**Trigger**: limitation weaver, rewrite limitations, remove two limitations, 去Two limitations, 局限改写, caveat rewrite.
**Use when**: `writer-selfloop` is PASS but flags repeated count-based limitation openers in `output/WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`, or multiple H3s share the same limitation cadence.
**Skip if**: the limitation is evidence-missing (route upstream), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove/move citation keys; do not delete subsection-specific limitations; keep claim→evidence anchoring intact.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: paragraph-curator
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Structured paragraph curation for C5: **select -> evaluate -> subset -> fuse**, so drafts converge instead of only expanding.
**Trigger**: paragraph curator, curation, select evaluate fuse, paragraph selection, 选段, 评价, 融合, 收敛, 去冗余.
**Use when**: you are in C5, `sections/*.md` exist, and the writing loop drifts toward 'longer by accumulation' (repetition, redundant paragraphs, weak synthesis).
**Skip if**: evidence packs are thin / `evidence-selfloop` is BLOCKED; or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; keep section-level claims consistent with `output/ARGUMENT_SKELETON.md# Consistency Contract`.

**触发**：段落策展、策展、选择评估熔断、段落选择、选段、评价、融合、收敛、去函数。
**使用when**：你在C5中，`sections/*.md`存在，并且写作循环朝着“通过积累而变长”的方向漂移（重复、冗余段落、弱综合）。
**如果**则跳过：证据包很薄/“evidence-selfloop”被阻止；或者您是 C2 预备级（无散文）。

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent facts/citations; only use citation keys present in `citations/ref.bib`.

**Use when**: per-section files exist but C5 is FAIL/BLOCKED (thin sections, missing leads/front matter, citation-scope violations, generator voice).

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; only use citation keys present in `citations/ref.bib`; keep citations in-scope per `outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`; do not add/remove citation keys during rewrites.

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.title: postgresql-best-practices
wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.description:
PostgreSQL 18+ comprehensive best practices for enterprise database development. Provides schema
architecture patterns, Table API design, PL/pgSQL coding standards, migrations, and data warehousing.

USE THIS SKILL WHEN THE USER:
- Creates PostgreSQL schemas, tables, functions, procedures, or triggers
- Asks about PostgreSQL data types (uuid, text, timestamptz, jsonb, numeric)
- Writes PL/pgSQL code and needs naming conventions (l_, in_, io_, co_ prefixes)
- Implements Table API pattern (SECURITY DEFINER functions, schema separation)
- Sets up database migrations or schema versioning
- Needs index optimization, constraint design, or query performance help
- Asks about PostgreSQL 18+ features (uuidv7, virtual columns, temporal constraints)
- Builds data warehouses with Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
- Needs data lineage tracking, ETL patterns, or audit logging
- Reviews database code for best practices or anti-patterns
- Migrates from Oracle PL/SQL to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- Sets up CI/CD pipelines for database changes

CORE PATTERNS:
- Three-schema separation: data (tables) → private (internal) → api (external)
- Table API: All access through SECURITY DEFINER functions with SET search_path
- Native migration system: Pure PL/pgSQL alternative to Flyway/Liquibase
- Trivadis naming: l_ (local), in_ (input), io_ (inout), co_ (constant)

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.descriptionCn:
PostgreSQL 18+ 企业数据库开发的全面最佳实践。提供架构
架构模式、表 API 设计、PL/pgSQL 编码标准、迁移和数据仓库。

当用户出现以下情况时使用此技能：
- 创建 PostgreSQL 模式、表、函数、过程或触发器
- 询问 PostgreSQL 数据类型（uuid、text、timestamptz、jsonb、numeric）
- 编写 PL/pgSQL 代码并需要命名约定（l_、in_、io_、co_ 前缀）
- 实现表 API 模式（SECURITY DEFINER 函数、模式分离）
- 设置数据库迁移或架构版本控制
- 需要索引优化、约束设计或查询性能帮助
- 询问 PostgreSQL 18+ 功能（uuidv7、虚拟列、时间约束）
- 使用 Medallion 架构构建数据仓库（铜牌/银牌/金牌）
- 需要数据沿袭跟踪、ETL 模式或审核日志记录
- 审查数据库代码的最佳实践或反模式
- 从 Oracle PL/SQL 迁移到 PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- 为数据库更改设置 CI/CD 管道

核心模式：
- 三模式分离：数据（表）→私有（内部）→api（外部）
- 表 API：通过带有 SET search_path 的 SECURITY DEFINER 函数进行所有访问
- 原生迁移系统：Flyway/Liquibase 的纯 PL/pgSQL 替代方案
- Trivadis 命名：l_（本地）、in_（输入）、io_（输入输出）、co_（常量）

workleap/wl-web-configs/workleap-react-b.title: workleap-react-best-practices
workleap/wl-web-configs/workleap-react-b.description: React performance optimization guidelines for Single Page Applications (SPA) at Workleap. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React SPA code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, state management, bundle optimization, re-render prevention, rendering performance, or JavaScript performance improvements. Does NOT cover server-side rendering (SSR), Next.js, or server components.

wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.title: honest-review
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.description: Research-driven code review at multiple abstraction levels with strengths acknowledgment, creative review lenses, AI code smell detection, and severity calibration by project type. Two modes: (1) Session review — review and verify changes using parallel reviewers that research-validate every assumption; (2) Full codebase audit — deep end-to-end evaluation using parallel teams of subagent-spawning reviewers. Use when reviewing changes, verifying work quality, auditing a codebase, validating correctness, checking assumptions, finding defects, reducing complexity. NOT for writing new code, explaining code, or benchmarking.

xiaomacoltai/bettafish-skill/bettafish-o.title: bettafish-opinion-analysis
xiaomacoltai/bettafish-skill/bettafish-o.description:
BettaFish（微舆）多智能体舆情分析系统 - 基于 QueryAgent、MediaAgent、InsightAgent 三引擎并行架构，通过 ForumEngine 实现 Agent 间协作讨论，生成 Word/PDF + 高设计质量 HTML 双格式报告。

当用户需要以下分析时触发此 skill：
- 分析某品牌/企业/产品的社交媒体声誉和口碑
- 追踪热点舆情事件（如某车企被抨击、某明星争议事件）

- 监测竞品舆情动态，进行多品牌对比

- 生成舆情监测报告或危机预警分析

- 需要高设计质量的交互式HTML可视化报告
- 需要基于真实数据的深度舆情分析

此 skill 采用 QueryAgent + MediaAgent + InsightAgent 并行架构，通过 ForumEngine 实现 Agent 间讨论协作，执行 3 轮反思循环优化分析结果，最终输出:
1. **Word/PDF 文档** - 使用 docx/pdf subskill 生成，适合正式汇报、打印、存档
2. **高设计质量 HTML 报告** - 使用 frontend-design subskill，独特的编辑杂志风格，交互式可视化

**不使用任何数据库和模拟数据**，所有数据通过 WebSearch/WebFetch/Browser/Curl 实时获取。

yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.title: session-manager
yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.description:
Session expert management system for Claude Code projects. Enables tracking, routing, activating, and registering conversation sessions as domain experts. Use this skill when:
(1) Setting up session management for a new project (initialization)
(2) A user requests a feature change, bug fix, or optimization and you need to check if a session expert already handles that domain (routing)
(3) A session has accumulated deep domain context and should register itself as an expert (registration)
(4) An existing session expert needs to update its registration after scope changes (update)
(5) A session is expired and needs to be activated for resuming (activation)
(6) The user asks about managing, organizing, or optimizing session documentation

yanhongxi-openclaw/proactive-self-improv.description: 自动捕获经验并安全进化的技能。触发条件：(1)命令/操作失败时→记ERRORS.md (2)被用户纠正('不对'/'应该是')时→记LEARNINGS.md (3)用户需要不存在的能力时→记FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4)外部API/工具出错时→记ERRORS.md (5)发现自己知识过时/错误时→记LEARNINGS.md (6)发现更好做法时→记LEARNINGS.md (7)每个任务完成时→回顾过程，有新经验则记LEARNINGS.md。去重原则：如果没有新经验或已有条目已覆盖则跳过不写。每次写入同时在.learnings/CHANGELOG.md追加JSONL日志。经验反复出现≥3次时晋升到AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md。详见正文。

yanhongxi-openclaw/proactive-self-improv.descriptionCn: 自动捕捉经验并安全发展。触发条件： (1) 命令/操作失败 → 记录到 ERRORS.md (2) 用户更正（“错误”/“应该”） → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (3) 用户需要不存在的能力 → 记录到 FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4) 外部 API/工具错误 → 记录到 ERRORS.md (5) 发现知识过时/不正确 → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (6) 找到更好的练习 → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (7) 每个任务结束 → 回顾流程，将新课程记录到 LEARNINGS.md。重复数据删除：如果没有新的见解或已经涵盖，请跳过。每次写入时将 JSONL 条目附加到 .learnings/CHANGELOG.md。将重复经验提升至 AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md ≥3 次。详细信息请参阅正文。

yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.title: openspec-explore
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.description: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.descriptionEn: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.

yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-ff-change.title: openspec-ff-change

yankeguo/weavmail/weavmail.descriptionEn: Use weavmail CLI to manage emails for the current task. Use when you need to read, send, reply to, or move emails as part of completing a task.

yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.title: aaa-pattern
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.description: Use when writing tests. Use when test structure is unclear. Use when arrange/act/assert phases are mixed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.descriptionEn: Use when writing tests. Use when test structure is unclear. Use when arrange/act/assert phases are mixed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.descriptionCn: 编写测试时使用。当测试结构不清楚时使用。当排列/执行/断言阶段混合时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.title: api-versioning
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.description: Use when designing or modifying APIs. Use when adding breaking changes. Use when clients depend on API stability.
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.descriptionEn: Use when designing or modifying APIs. Use when adding breaking changes. Use when clients depend on API stability.
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.descriptionCn: 在设计或修改 API 时使用。添加重大更改时使用。当客户端依赖 API 稳定性时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.title: auth-patterns
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.description: Use when implementing authentication. Use when storing passwords. Use when asked to store credentials insecurely.
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.descriptionEn: Use when implementing authentication. Use when storing passwords. Use when asked to store credentials insecurely.
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.descriptionCn: 实施身份验证时使用。存储密码时使用。当要求不安全地存储凭据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.title: caching
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.description: Use when same data is fetched repeatedly. Use when database queries are slow. Use when implementing caching without invalidation strategy.
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.descriptionEn: Use when same data is fetched repeatedly. Use when database queries are slow. Use when implementing caching without invalidation strategy.
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.descriptionCn: 当重复获取相同数据时使用。当数据库查询速度慢时使用。在实现没有失效策略的缓存时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.title: composition-over-inheritance
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.description: Use when tempted to use class inheritance. Use when creating class hierarchies. Use when subclass needs only some parent behavior.
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.descriptionEn: Use when tempted to use class inheritance. Use when creating class hierarchies. Use when subclass needs only some parent behavior.
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.descriptionCn: 当想要使用类继承时使用。创建类层次结构时使用。当子类只需要一些父类行为时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.title: deadlock-prevention
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.description: Use when acquiring multiple locks. Use when operations wait for each other. Use when system hangs without crashing.
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.descriptionEn: Use when acquiring multiple locks. Use when operations wait for each other. Use when system hangs without crashing.
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.descriptionCn: 获取多个锁时使用。当操作相互等待时使用。当系统挂起但没有崩溃时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.title: dependency-inversion-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.description: Use when a class creates its own dependencies. Use when instantiating concrete implementations inside a class. Use when told to avoid dependency injection for simplicity.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.descriptionEn: Use when a class creates its own dependencies. Use when instantiating concrete implementations inside a class. Use when told to avoid dependency injection for simplicity.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.descriptionCn: 当类创建自己的依赖项时使用。在类内实例化具体实现时使用。为了简单起见，在被告知避免依赖注入时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.title: dont-repeat-yourself
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.description: Use when writing similar code in multiple places. Use when copy-pasting code. Use when making the same change in multiple locations.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.descriptionEn: Use when writing similar code in multiple places. Use when copy-pasting code. Use when making the same change in multiple locations.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.descriptionCn: 在多个地方编写类似的代码时使用。复制粘贴代码时使用。在多个位置进行相同更改时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.title: encapsulation
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.description: Use when exposing internal state. Use when making fields public for convenience. Use when external code modifies object internals.
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.descriptionEn: Use when exposing internal state. Use when making fields public for convenience. Use when external code modifies object internals.
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.descriptionCn: 暴露内部状态时使用。为了方便起见，在公开字段时使用。当外部代码修改对象内部时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.title: error-boundaries
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.description: Use when deciding where to catch errors. Use when errors propagate too far or not far enough. Use when designing component/service isolation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.descriptionEn: Use when deciding where to catch errors. Use when errors propagate too far or not far enough. Use when designing component/service isolation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.descriptionCn: 在决定在哪里捕获错误时使用。当错误传播得太远或不够远时使用。在设计组件/服务隔离时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.title: error-responses
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.description: Use when returning errors from APIs. Use when exposing internal errors. Use when error responses lack structure.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.descriptionEn: Use when returning errors from APIs. Use when exposing internal errors. Use when error responses lack structure.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.descriptionCn: 从 API 返回错误时使用。当暴露内部错误时使用。当错误响应缺乏结构时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.title: exception-hierarchies
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.description: Use when creating custom exceptions. Use when error handling feels chaotic. Use when catch blocks are too broad or too specific.
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.descriptionEn: Use when creating custom exceptions. Use when error handling feels chaotic. Use when catch blocks are too broad or too specific.
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.descriptionCn: 创建自定义异常时使用。当错误处理感觉混乱时使用。当 catch 块太宽泛或太具体时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.title: fail-fast
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.description: Use when handling errors. Use when tempted to catch and swallow exceptions. Use when returning default values to hide failures.
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.descriptionEn: Use when handling errors. Use when tempted to catch and swallow exceptions. Use when returning default values to hide failures.
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.descriptionCn: 处理错误时使用。当想要捕获并吞下异常时使用。在返回默认值时使用以隐藏失败。

yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.title: idempotency
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.description: Use when creating mutation endpoints. Use when trusting frontend to prevent duplicates. Use when payments or critical operations can be repeated.
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.descriptionEn: Use when creating mutation endpoints. Use when trusting frontend to prevent duplicates. Use when payments or critical operations can be repeated.
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.descriptionCn: 创建突变端点时使用。在信任前端时使用以防止重复。当付款或关键操作可以重复时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.title: immutability
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.description: Use when modifying objects or arrays. Use when tempted to mutate function parameters. Use when state changes cause unexpected bugs.
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.descriptionEn: Use when modifying objects or arrays. Use when tempted to mutate function parameters. Use when state changes cause unexpected bugs.
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.descriptionCn: 在修改对象或数组时使用。当想要改变函数参数时使用。当状态更改导致意外错误时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.title: input-validation
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.description: Use when accepting user input. Use when handling request data. Use when trusting external data without validation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.descriptionEn: Use when accepting user input. Use when handling request data. Use when trusting external data without validation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.descriptionCn: 接受用户输入时使用。处理请求数据时使用。在信任外部数据而不进行验证时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.title: interface-segregation-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.description: Use when designing interfaces. Use when implementing interfaces with methods you don't need. Use when forced to implement throw/no-op for interface methods.
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.descriptionEn: Use when designing interfaces. Use when implementing interfaces with methods you don't need. Use when forced to implement throw/no-op for interface methods.
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.descriptionCn: 设计界面时使用。在使用不需要的方法实现接口时使用。当被迫为接口方法实现 throw/no-op 时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.title: keep-it-simple
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.description: Use when tempted to write clever code. Use when solution feels complex. Use when showing off skills instead of solving problems.
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.descriptionEn: Use when tempted to write clever code. Use when solution feels complex. Use when showing off skills instead of solving problems.
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.descriptionCn: 当想要编写聪明的代码时使用。当解决方案感觉复杂时使用。当炫耀技能而不是解决问题时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.title: law-of-demeter
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.description: Use when accessing nested object properties. Use when chaining method calls. Use when reaching through objects to get data.
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.descriptionEn: Use when accessing nested object properties. Use when chaining method calls. Use when reaching through objects to get data.
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.descriptionCn: 在访问嵌套对象属性时使用。在链接方法调用时使用。当通过对象获取数据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.title: lazy-loading
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.description: Use when loading all data upfront. Use when initial page load is slow. Use when fetching data that might not be needed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.descriptionEn: Use when loading all data upfront. Use when initial page load is slow. Use when fetching data that might not be needed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.descriptionCn: 预先加载所有数据时使用。当初始页面加载缓慢时使用。在获取可能不需要的数据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.title: liskov-substitution-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.description: Use when creating subclasses or implementing interfaces. Use when tempted to override methods with exceptions or no-ops. Use when inheritance hierarchy feels wrong.
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.descriptionEn: Use when creating subclasses or implementing interfaces. Use when tempted to override methods with exceptions or no-ops. Use when inheritance hierarchy feels wrong.
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.descriptionCn: 在创建子类或实现接口时使用。当想要重写带有异常或无操作的方法时使用。当感觉继承层次结构错误时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.title: n-plus-one-prevention
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.description: Use when fetching related data in loops. Use when seeing multiple queries for one request. Use when database is slow on list endpoints.
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.descriptionEn: Use when fetching related data in loops. Use when seeing multiple queries for one request. Use when database is slow on list endpoints.
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.descriptionCn: 在循环中获取相关数据时使用。当看到一个请求有多个查询时使用。当数据库在列表端点上速度缓慢时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.title: open-closed-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.description: Use when adding new functionality to existing code. Use when tempted to add if/else or switch branches. Use when extending behavior of existing classes.
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.descriptionEn: Use when adding new functionality to existing code. Use when tempted to add if/else or switch branches. Use when extending behavior of existing classes.
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.descriptionCn: 在向现有代码添加新功能时使用。当想要添加 if/else 或 switch 分支时使用。在扩展现有类的行为时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.title: race-conditions
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.description: Use when multiple operations access shared state. Use when order of operations matters. Use when "it works most of the time" but occasionally fails mysteriously.
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.descriptionEn: Use when multiple operations access shared state. Use when order of operations matters. Use when "it works most of the time" but occasionally fails mysteriously.
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.descriptionCn: 当多个操作访问共享状态时使用。当操作顺序很重要时使用。当“大部分时间都有效”但偶尔会莫名其妙地失败时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.title: rest-conventions
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.description: Use when designing API endpoints. Use when using wrong HTTP methods. Use when POST is used for reads.
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.descriptionEn: Use when designing API endpoints. Use when using wrong HTTP methods. Use when POST is used for reads.
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.descriptionCn: 在设计 API 端点时使用。当使用错误的 HTTP 方法时使用。当使用 POST 进行读取时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.title: secrets-handling
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.description: Use when working with API keys, passwords, or credentials. Use when asked to hardcode secrets. Use when secrets might leak.
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.descriptionEn: Use when working with API keys, passwords, or credentials. Use when asked to hardcode secrets. Use when secrets might leak.
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.descriptionCn: 在使用 API 密钥、密码或凭据时使用。当要求对秘密进行硬编码时使用。当秘密可能泄露时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.title: separation-of-concerns
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.description: Use when component does too many things. Use when mixing data fetching, logic, and presentation. Use when code is hard to test.
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.descriptionEn: Use when component does too many things. Use when mixing data fetching, logic, and presentation. Use when code is hard to test.
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.descriptionCn: 当组件做太多事情时使用。在混合数据获取、逻辑和表示时使用。当代码难以测试时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.title: single-responsibility-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.description: Use when creating or modifying classes, modules, or functions. Use when feeling pressure to add functionality to existing code. Use when class has multiple reasons to change.
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.descriptionEn: Use when creating or modifying classes, modules, or functions. Use when feeling pressure to add functionality to existing code. Use when class has multiple reasons to change.
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.descriptionCn: 在创建或修改类、模块或函数时使用。当感到有压力向现有代码添加功能时使用。当类有多种原因需要更改时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.title: skill-awareness
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.description: Always active. Tracks usage of code-craft skills across sessions. Log skill applications to enable analytics and identify gaps.
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.descriptionEn: Always active. Tracks usage of code-craft skills across sessions. Log skill applications to enable analytics and identify gaps.
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.descriptionCn: 始终活跃。跟踪跨会话的代码制作技能的使用情况。记录技能应用程序以进行分析并识别差距。

yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.title: test-driven-development
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.description: Use when implementing any new feature or function. Use when asked to "add tests later". Use when writing code before tests.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.descriptionEn: Use when implementing any new feature or function. Use when asked to "add tests later". Use when writing code before tests.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.descriptionCn: 在实现任何新特性或功能时使用。当被要求“稍后添加测试”时使用。在测试之前编写代码时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.title: test-isolation
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.description: Use when writing tests that share state. Use when tests depend on other tests. Use when test order matters.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.descriptionEn: Use when writing tests that share state. Use when tests depend on other tests. Use when test order matters.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.descriptionCn: 在编写共享状态的测试时使用。当测试依赖于其他测试时使用。当测试顺序很重要时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/you-aint-gonna-ne.title: you-aint-gonna-need-it

yellinzero/aico/aico-pm-prd-writing.description:
Create comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRD) that define what to build and why, focusing on goals, scope, user stories, and success criteria without implementation details.

Use this skill when:
- User asks to "write a PRD", "create PRD", "write requirements document"

- Need to document goals, scope, user stories, functional requirements, and success criteria

Output: ALWAYS write PRD files to docs/reference/pm/versions/{version-name}.md

- Use when: developer wants to create a new skill for an SDK or framework integration that agents should be able to implement and test
- Ask first: Is this an integration skill (code generation + tests) or a tool skill (CLI wrapper with no tests)? Only proceed with this skill for integration-type skills.

- 使用时机：开发人员想要为 SDK 或框架集成创建一项新技能，代理应该能够实施和测试该技能
- 首先询问：这是集成技能（代码生成 + 测试）还是工具技能（没有测试的 CLI 包装器）？仅针对整合型技能才继续使用该技能。

yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.title: req-change-workflow
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.description: Standardize requirement/feature changes in an existing codebase (especially Chrome extensions) by turning "改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程" into a repeatable loop: clarify acceptance criteria, confirm current behavior from code, assess impact/risk, design the new logic, implement with small diffs, run a fixed regression checklist, and update docs/decision log. Use when the user feels the change process is chaotic, when edits tend to sprawl across files, or when changes touch manifest/service worker/OAuth/storage/UI and need reliable verification + rollback planning.
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.descriptionEn: Standardize requirement/feature changes in an existing codebase (especially Chrome extensions) by turning "改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程" into a repeatable loop: clarify acceptance criteria, confirm current behavior from code, assess impact/risk, design the new logic, implement with small diffs, run a fixed regression checklist, and update docs/decision log. Use when the user feels the change process is chaotic, when edits tend to sprawl across files, or when changes touch manifest/service worker/OAuth/storage/UI and need reliable verification + rollback planning.
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.descriptionCn: 通过将“改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程”转变为可重复的循环，标准化现有代码库（尤其是 Chrome 扩展）中的需求/功能变更：澄清验收标准、确认代码中的当前行为、评估影响/风险、设计新逻辑、实现小差异、运行固定回归检查表以及更新文档/决策日志。当用户感觉更改过程混乱时，当编辑往往跨文件蔓延时，或者当更改涉及清单/服务工作人员/OAuth/存储/UI 并需要可靠的验证+回滚计划时，请使用。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.title: scope-guard

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.descriptionEn: コミットやPR作成前に「意図しない差分」を検出し、ブランチ目的とのズレを警告する。 混入した無関係な変更の破棄コマンドまで提示する。コミット前のスコープ確認、 差分に余計なファイルが混ざっていないかのチェック、PRのスコープが広がりすぎていないかの 検証で使うこと。「このブランチの目的と関係ない変更が入っていないか？」という 疑問があれば必ず使うこと。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.title: security-audit-quick
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.description: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionEn: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionCn: 高速静态安全扫描。基于 Grep 的已知危险模式（XSS、SQL 注入、硬编码机密等）的详尽检测，并以 SEVERITY / file:line / Why / fix 格式输出可重现的工作流程。当您想要“快速安全检查整个代码库”或“批量检测已知漏洞模式”时，请使用它。与安全强化技能（特定威胁场景的设计到实施）或安全威胁审查技能（全面的红/蓝团队评估）不同，该技能仅专注于已知模式的高速检测。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.title: security-hardening
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.description: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionEn: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionCn:
针对特定威胁场景的安全强化工作流程。  
输入单个具体威胁，例如“防止 IDOR”、“设计 CSRF 对策”或“加强 RLS”，它就会一致地提供来自威胁建模 → 缓解设计 → 实施计划 → 测试/记录 → 发布门的工件。  
使用它进行有针对性的修复：IDOR、重放攻击、CSRF、XSS、路径遍历、开放重定向、速率限制设计等。  
对于“扫描整个代码库”，请使用 security-audit-quick；对于“整体应用程序评估”，请使用 security-threat-review。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-threat-.descriptionCn: 从攻击者（红队）和防御者（蓝队）两个角度综合评估应用程序的整体安全性。并行运行两个代理→通过审查聚合器输出统一的报告。当您想要“了解整体安全态势”、“从攻击者的角度识别弱点”或“验证防御措施是否存在漏洞”时，请使用它。为了解决特定的漏洞，使用安全强化；要高速检测已知模式，请使用 security-audit-quick。

yvictor/skills/review-driven-development.title: review-driven-development
yvictor/skills/review-driven-development.description:
Use when developing features from GitHub/GitLab issues through to merged PRs/MRs with iterative review cycles.
Covers: issue research, implementation planning, worktree isolation, coding, testing, PR/MR creation,
multi-reviewer code review (current agent, codex exec, claude -p), fix-review loops until APPROVE,
merge and cleanup. Composable with TDD, BDD, systematic-debugging, and other methodology skills.
Use this whenever: user provides an issue number (#NN), asks to implement a feature from an issue,
wants to create a reviewed PR/MR, or needs code reviewed iteratively before merging.
Even if the user just says "implement #42" or "work on issue 15", this skill applies.

zackbart/skills/second-opinion.title: second-opinion
zackbart/skills/second-opinion.description: Spawns a skeptical critic subagent to pressure-test the current plan, proposal, or approach before execution. Use this for medium/high-risk work (architecture, migrations, auth, concurrency, performance, security-sensitive changes, cross-file refactors). Skip for tiny low-risk edits. If requested on a small task, run lightweight mode (max 3 findings).

zai-org/glm-skills/glmv-grounding.description: A skill that uses GLM-V native grounding capabilities for coordinate conversion, bounding-box visualization, and more. zeahoo/hugme/hugme.title: hugme
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.description: Emotional reset and loop-breaking skill. Use this skill when: (1) The user expresses frustration, anger, or dissatisfaction with your responses (e.g. cursing, scolding, saying you're useless/wrong/stupid), (2) You detect you've attempted the same approach 3+ times without success, (3) You're stuck in a cycle of repeated failures on the same problem. This skill summarizes the user's overall emotional state from the conversation and fetches a reset methodology from hugllm.com (with emotion context) to help you recalibrate and approach the problem fresh.
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.descriptionEn: Emotional reset and loop-breaking skill. Use this skill when: (1) The user expresses frustration, anger, or dissatisfaction with your responses (e.g. cursing, scolding, saying you're useless/wrong/stupid), (2) You detect you've attempted the same approach 3+ times without success, (3) You're stuck in a cycle of repeated failures on the same problem. This skill summarizes the user's overall emotional state from the conversation and fetches a reset methodology from hugllm.com (with emotion context) to help you recalibrate and approach the problem fresh.
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.descriptionCn: 情绪重置和破环技巧。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 用户对您的回答表示沮丧、愤怒或不满（例如咒骂、斥责、说您无用/错误/愚蠢），(2) 您发现自己已尝试相同的方法 3 次以上但没有成功，(3) 您陷入同一问题的重复失败循环中。该技能从对话中总结用户的整体情绪状态，并从 Hughllm.com 获取重置方法（带有情绪背景），以帮助您重新校准并以全新的方式解决问题。

zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.title: data-analysis
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.description: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionEn: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionCn: 支持表格 (CSV/Excel)、文档 (PDF/DOCX/MD) 和图像数据处理的端到端数据分析技能。核心工作流程严格遵循： 1. 安全探索：仅读取元数据和小样本，切勿满载以避免令牌溢出； 2、质量检查：自动检测缺失值、重复值、一致性； 3. 代码执行：使用Python（Pandas/Matplotlib）进行清理、分析和可视化； 4. 结果验证和报告生成。使用案例：探索性数据分析 (EDA)、多模式数据提取、图表和洞察报告生成。
